name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Will you add your name to signal your support for a $35 cap on insulin for ALL patients?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Patient spending on insulin nearly tripled from 2002 to 2013 — then nearly doubled again between 2012 and 2016.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1844%2E4032634%2EHxvM2m)
---
Democrats are putting government on the side of families, not Big Pharma. Just about everybody in America either takes insulin or knows and loves someone who does. Access to insulin is a matter of life and death for diabetes patients — and drug companies have taken advantage of this, plus the fact that there’s little market competition, to hike up prices. Before President Biden took office, the cost of insulin had increased by over 1,200% since the 1990s, and patient spending on insulin nearly tripled from 2002 to 2013 — then nearly doubled again between 2012 and 2016. About one in six Americans with diabetes had to ration insulin because they could not afford it. But starting this year we began to tackle these horrifying statistics. Because of the Inflation Reduction Act that passed in 2022, seniors on Medicare didn’t have to pay more than $35 a month for their insulin. Every Democrat in Congress voted for this life-saving legislation. Every Republican in Congress voted against it. Many Republicans even stopped us from extending the same cap to cover every American who needs insulin. They’d rather protect Big Pharma’s profits than protect lives. It’s shameful. But we’re staying in the fight. **I’m proud to co-sponsor the bipartisan Affordable Insulin Now Act of 2023 introduced by Senators Raphael Warnock and John Kennedy. This legislation would create a $35-per-month cap on insulin products for everyone — both individuals with private insurance plans and those who are uninsured.** [**We’ve got to keep fighting hard to hold Big Pharma accountable and make our government work for families. Will you add your name to signal your support for this critical policy?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-affordable-insulin/?source=EMZ17Z_PHA_E_20231206_V1S1&t=8&akid=1844%2E4032634%2EHxvM2m) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-affordable-insulin/?source=EMZ17Z_PHA_E_20231206_V1S1&t=9&akid=1844%2E4032634%2EHxvM2m)
---
Now, even though we couldn’t extend the $35 cap to all Americans in last year’s legislation, we still sent a message to Big Pharma — and we’ve gotten results.
Thanks to the momentum from this push, and public pressure from consumers, the three top insulin manufacturers have capped costs for insulin products at $35 a month. And by staying in the fight, we can make this a reality for all.
Our fight to reduce health care costs for families doesn’t stop here. But this is a critical next step in recognizing health care as a basic human right for everyone — and it will make a substantial difference in the everyday lives of people across the country. I’ll keep fighting for everyone to get the care they need.
[**Let’s send a message to Big Pharma: You can’t just keep jacking up prices forever. Add your name to let me know you agree with this plan to lower the costs of insulin for all patients — and let’s fight side by side to get this done.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-affordable-insulin/?source=EMZ17Z_PHA_E_20231206_V1S1&t=10&akid=1844%2E4032634%2EHxvM2m)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

subject: One year ago today

body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] One year ago today, friend, we made history – again. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Thanks to the support of folks like you on this people-powered team, we defied all the odds, proving the political pundits and naysayers wrong, to win our runoff election. We kept Georgia blue and secured the Senate majority for Democrats.
I’ll never lose sight of what that victory felt like. What it meant. As a kid who grew up in public housing – with 11 brothers and sisters and parents who were short on money but long on love and faith – I could only ever dream of becoming Georgia’s first Black senator. Thank you.
But I’m also reaching out today because you understand well the urgency of our elections. Our razor-thin Senate majority is once again on the line, with just about every election expert out there calling Democrats’ path to holding the Senate the most difficult it’s ever been.
Well, they said that about Georgia. They said it would be near impossible for us to flip it blue. But we did because people like you never stopped believing and never stopped fighting – chipping in $5 or whatever they could afford because you believed change was possible. So today, I’m coming to you again because I promised Kirsten Gillibrand in New York that I’d help them raise $25,000 before midnight so they can win their battleground race and keep the Senate blue.
I’ve counted on you before, friend. Can Kirsten and I count on you again to protect our Senate majority? Please, split a donation of $5 or whatever you can spare between our campaigns so that we can keep New York blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/warnock_gfs?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
As somebody who fought and won a battleground race, I know this fundraising goal to help Kirsten win is essential. I appreciate you helping out and donating whatever you can.
– Rev. Raphael Warnock

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Friend, Instead of heeding the demands of the American people for a ceasefire, Congress just passed a resolution trying to silence our anti-war movement. I voted against House Resolution 894, a dangerous Republican-led resolution that falsely claims it’s antisemitic to oppose the policies of Israel’s government. As Jewish Voice for Peace Action wrote about this resolution:
> _“Conflating anti-Zionism with antisemitism conflates all Jews with the Israeli state and endangers Jewish communities. Just as blaming all Jews for Israel's actions is antisemitic, so is the inverse: suggesting that Jewish people are synonymous with Israel and Zionism.”_
The resolution endangers Jews, Palestinians, and people of all backgrounds who are speaking up for Palestinians’ human rights. Re-electing Bob Casey is mission-critical.

name: Martin Heinrich
subject: Addressing gun violence
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Martin Heinrich for Senate
body:
We’ve seen at least 38 deadly mass shootings in the United States this year. That is more than any year since at least 2006. Earlier today, there was a tragic act of gun violence in Las Vegas, Nevada — the same city as a horrific event in 2017, the deadliest mass shooting in modern American history. We cannot allow yet another community to experience the devastation of gun violence. That is why Congress must pass my _Gas-Operated Semi-Automatic Firearms Exclusion (GOSAFE) Act_ without delay to help get deadly weapons off the streets and prevent these tragedies. It’s past time to draw a line between the firearms Americans use for hunting, sporting, and self-defense — and deadly weapons of war. We can protect the Second Amendment for responsible gun owners while regulating gas-operated firearms, high-capacity ammunition magazines, and conversion devices like bump stocks. The _GOSAFE Act_ will regulate firearms based on the lethality of their internal mechanisms. No one will be able to buy a new gas-operated semi-automatic rifle if its fixed magazine holds more than 10 cartridges. This would slow shooters’ rate of fire and force them to reload sooner, providing first responders more time to disarm them and tend to victims. In short, **this legislation will curb mass shootings and save lives.** We can and must protect responsible gun ownership while keeping deadly weapons out of the hands of those who could turn them against our communities. We must take action as we see these deadly acts of gun violence rise. Last year, we made history by taking the first congressional action on gun safety reform in decades. We can see the _GOSAFE Act_ become law, too, if we come together behind our shared values. Thanks for your support. — Martin

It’s past time to draw a line between the firearms Americans use for hunting, sporting, and self-defense — and deadly weapons of war. We can protect the Second Amendment for responsible gun owners while regulating gas-operated firearms, high-capacity ammunition magazines, and conversion devices like bump stocks. The GOSAFE Act will regulate firearms based on the lethality of their internal mechanisms. No one will be able to buy a new gas-operated semi-automatic rifle if its fixed magazine holds more than 10 cartridges. This would slow shooters’ rate of fire and force them to reload sooner, providing first responders more time to disarm them and tend to victims. In short, this legislation will curb mass shootings and save lives. We can and must protect responsible gun ownership while keeping deadly weapons out of the hands of those who could turn them against our communities. We must take action as we see these deadly acts of gun violence rise. Last year, we made history by taking the first congressional action on gun safety reform in decades. We can see the GOSAFE Act become law, too, if we come together behind our shared values. Thanks for your support. — Martin | Paid for by Martin Heinrich for Senate Senator Martin Heinrich is committed to helping New Mexico become a leader in defense, tech, and energy with opportunities in every corner. **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:**
December 6, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com)
**Christie Super PAC Debate Statement: Only One Candidate On That Stage Offered A Clear Vision For The Future**
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Bill Palatucci, Chairman of Tell It Like It Is PAC, issued the following statement after the fourth Republican presidential debate in Tuscaloosa, Alabama:
“Republican voters had a clear choice tonight between three candidates auditioning to become Donald Trump’s running mate, and Chris Christie, who offered a bold and unequivocal break from the status quo. Chris Christie is the only one with the vision for the future, a record of conservative accomplishments and the willingness to speak truth about the state of the party. A nomination of Trump or someone in his mold ensures another four years of Joe Biden as president, and that is something America cannot afford.”
Below is a sampling of what others are saying about Chris Christie’s debate performance:
[Geraldo Rivera](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=3ee35b83e3&e=d0a9afa930): Governor Christie just took Ramaswamy to school over his wretched manners. Dude is really obnoxious...
[Shawna Mizelle, CBS News](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=5fe25a0c21&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie calls out Trump, saying the former president doesn't "have the guts to show up" on the debate stage. "He is unfit to be president," Christie says.
[Blake Burman, NewsNation](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=b5ee4c69db&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie notes it has been 17 minutes and the other three candidates haven't mentioned Donald Trump. @NewsNation
[Marc Caputo](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=98b9f1dcf6&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie, acting as a sort of narrator-participant in the debate, chides DeSantis for giving a “hosanna” about his military service & not saying if he would use American military power to rescue U.S hostages in Gaza. Christie said he would
[Ellen Carmichael](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=e842b59081&e=d0a9afa930): Christie has been great on Trump. It’s very necessary.
[John Avlon, CNN](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=b49cda6116&e=d0a9afa930): Christie having a very strong debate tonight out of the gate
[Michael Duncan, Ruthless Podcast](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=2d8c658705&e=d0a9afa930): Christie just owned Vivek lmao #GOPDebate
[Seth Mandel](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=63e41ad50f&e=d0a9afa930): Christie made Vivek mad by murdering him
[Scott Jennings](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=2931b393c0&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie -- bravo #GOPDebate
[Reagan Reese, Daily Caller](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=8c9512b11f&e=d0a9afa930): Christie really getting how he feels about DeSantis and Ramaswamy's previous debate performances off his chest tonight. The former NJ Gov says this would be the fourth debate in a row that Ramaswamy would be the "most obnoxious blow hard" in the first 20 minutes.
[Heather Nauert](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=3d52399c8b&e=d0a9afa930): Rude. Obnoxious. Insulting. Inaccurate. He doesn’t know anything about the issues. Give @VivekGRamaswamy a reality show and let’s be done w it. Thanks, @GovChristie for calling it as it is.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God’s Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.

| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. ---
| | We’re offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

-- From January to February, we’ll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we’ll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we’ll gain wisdom from Solomon’s reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we’ll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37591%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eleZyBXU2wb1nAzAb7BtDw&sysid=1).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I’m very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:
Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37508%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bRKU8lEICZl6ulOMviXGKw&sysid=1)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it’s important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37509%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UGKjWF%2bwsfx%2fkxBjp3OlDw&sysid=1 "Once youâ€TMve
finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help
me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37508%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bRKU8lEICZl6ulOMviXGKw&sysid=1)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _“Don’t complain. Do something about it.” _

---
| | | So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37508%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bRKU8lEICZl6ulOMviXGKw&sysid=1)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick-me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37508%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bRKU8lEICZl6ulOMviXGKw&sysid=1)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **FOURTH** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help us keep momentum STRONG!>>](https://secure.winred.com/team-stand-for-america/support-nikki-now-underdog-tv?sc=PRentalTV&recurring=true&utm_campaign=20231207_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1420139-2667&utm_medium=emailp&utm_source=WG-YAN2.103100&utm_content=20231207_introducing-myself&ex_tid=20231207_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1420139-2667&utm_content=tv-yan-20231207&xunv=tv-yan-20231207 "It would mean a lot to me
if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the
strength of my campaign post-debate. >> ")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since the last debate!

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37500%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=a9wda6zlQ6iRxY5%2bG7Ir%2fQ&sysid=1 "Will you consider making a
one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?")**

---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I’m hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help to make it across the finish line- starting right now.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37516%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fUZ9PWg%2frXBM6UEkNTTdcA&sysid=1 " I need your help â€“
starting right now. ")**

Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37508%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bRKU8lEICZl6ulOMviXGKw&sysid=1)

Nikki Haley

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37517%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0YgYJRWt2g5XkvyqM1PEsg&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Merch")
---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37518%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1U5mJ%2fzDvLreccZDw3ILfw&sysid=1 "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37519%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Kz68FRWwSuo8gIk3p2nhzg&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37510%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0FMGZWC9ok%2bDjaLDlADe%2bw&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. subject: Entering the 2024 race

body:
Today, I am officially announcing my campaign for Congress in Montana’s Second Congressional District.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686848%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XACJ258iYkESdqfN3MHOCA&sysid=1)
---
Friend,

My name is Troy Downing. I’m a husband, father, Combat Veteran, and proud conservative Patriot.

_**[I officially announced my candidacy for Congress in Montana’s Second Congressional District.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686849%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wnWbvfBeND18tn1SvPne2A&sysid=1 "I officially announced my
candidacy for Congress in Montana’s Second Congressional District. ")**_
---
| | [JOIN TEAM TROY >> ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686840%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ph5RpfIRs7g8dL7uW9KU9Q&sysid=1)
---
On September 11, 2001, America suffered the deadliest terror attack in our history. It was a day that changed the world, changed our nation, and will forever live in infamy. Like so many Americans, I was deeply affected by those events, which led me to make a decision that would change the course of my life.

**In the wake of 9/11, I enlisted in the U.S. Air Force/Air National Guard, answering the call to serve our country and fight for freedom. **

For eight years, I proudly served in a USAF Combat Search and Rescue squadron, volunteering for two combat deployments to Afghanistan in support of Operation Enduring Freedom and the Global War on Terrorism.

I fought beside and witnessed the unwavering dedication of my brothers and sisters in arms \- our brave servicemen and women who sacrificed so much for our freedoms. **Service is not merely a job; it is a way of life.**
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686841%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DDgaCZ0mYXkuVYRRaneDbA&sysid=1)
---
But times have changed, Friend. Far too many politicians have forgotten what their actual job in Washington is: to _**SERVE**_.

I’m tired of watching politicians run for office to gain celebrity status, social media fame, book deals, and ego boosts. Too many politicians want to simply “be” in Congress, they have no interest in actually “doing” the work. I refuse to sit back and watch power-hungry Democrats collect a paycheck bigger than what most hard-working Americans will ever see.

Our nation deserves leaders who have walked the walk and who understand the sacrifices our veterans make every day to keep our nation free. **Service is in my blood._[That's why I am running to become Montana's next Congressman and asking you to become one of my campaign’s first official supporters.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686842%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LH%2f%2fGjQ2YWZzv%2ba3ATC0nQ&sysid=1 "That's why I am running to
become Montana's next Congressman and asking you to become one of my campaign’s
first official supporters.")_**
---
| | [BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR >> ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686843%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QTrwsWv8weLIduEG1y2lcQ&sysid=1)
---
When I get to Washington, I will fight for policies that strengthen our national security, support our veterans, and promote economic prosperity for all. I will work to preserve the America we know and love, and _**[I WILL get the job done for Americans across the country.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686844%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4duUzuRzV2%2fKmCHd0oY2CQ&sysid=1 "I WILL get the job done
for Americans across the country.")**_

As a Combat Veteran, I’m not used to being in the position of asking for help. On the other hand, I’m not too proud to admit that I need it. Getting this campaign off the ground will require the financial support of American patriots from across our state and nation, and _**[every single dollar will make a difference.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686955%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qN0jy60hvg8uzbejFwmUQA&sysid=1 "every single dollar will
make a difference. ")**_

Friend, can I count on you to _**[join my team with a donation of $10?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686956%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=r4EGDUVlpOv3MkSlakNjLg&sysid=1 "join my team with a
donation of $10? ")**_
---
| | [BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR >> CHIP IN $10 ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686957%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gjfQUJPIIU%2bfqIWbYe%2fiLw&sysid=1)
---
| | [BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR >> CHIP IN MORE](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686958%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4%2b%2b%2fRmAQOgJ0NW9tCqDN8g&sysid=1)
---
Thank you for taking the time to read my message today. May God bless you, may God bless Montana, and may God bless these great United States of America.

Respectfully,
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686959%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cx528plm%2bOg44E1ZM8v%2fMA&sysid=1)

Republican for Congress

[](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xjyujtl-dihkkhuuli-r/) Friend, Monday, I stood with the majority of Oregonians who agree that **we need to repeal Measure 110. ** [WATCH MY TESTIMONY 📲](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xjyujtl-dihkkhuuli-y/) [](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xjyujtl-dihkkhuuli-j/) I urge lawmakers to reconsider the implications of Measure 110. # The Open Border Makes All Problems Worse
# By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Open borders exacerbate many difficulties regular Americans face each day. Problems like crime, healthcare, drugs, inflation, our national debt, poor-performing schools, and countless others. Illegal immigration makes things much worse for you and all Nevadans.
Every person who enters our Country illegally costs American taxpayers more than $10,000 a year. That money is spent on social programs to house, feed, educate, and provide medical care. Since President Biden took office, ten million people have entered our country illegally. Simple math translates to an annual cost of $100 billion dollars ($10,000 x 10,000,000,000 = $100,000,000,000). That's right! One hundred billion dollars every year! We don't have that money, so we must borrow it, adding to our national debt and driving up inflation. You pay this cost in higher taxes and higher prices for everything you buy.
Have you been to a hospital emergency room lately? If so, you probably had to wait in a long line. Illegal immigration is making these lines much longer. Criminals who break our laws to enter our country go to the emergency room for all their healthcare needs. And, of course, they do not pay for the care they receive. As a result, you pay more for healthcare and wait longer to receive it.
Less than half of Nevada's school children are performing at grade level. Illegal immigration has made this problem much worse. Teachers must accommodate non-English speaking children. The school district must hire translators and specialists to work with these students. Diverting funds, teachers, and resources from the children of tax-paying Nevadans means our children don't get the education they need and deserve.
Crime is rising in Southern Nevada and across the country. Thousands of criminals have crossed our porous southern border. Mexican cartels freely operate in the United States. They bring with them a plethora of crimes, including drugs, guns, gangs, murder, burglary, shoplifting, and human trafficking, not to mention the potential for terrorist acts. Innocent Americans are subjected to rising risk of loss, injury, and death, while scarce law enforcement resources are diverted away from protecting you and your family.
Securing our borders won't fix all Americans' challenges, but it will make them more manageable. As your Representative in Congress, I will fight to secure the border and enforce current laws. I will work with others to create an immigration system that only allows people into our country who can support themselves and make an immediate contribution to our Country.
The Biden Era of open borders must end! That goes for "Ridin with Biden" Dina Titus as well.
---
---
Southern Border Crisis
---

******* Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: Do you support voters having to present identification at the polls? -M.R. A. Yes. The vast majority of Nevadans support voter ID. It only makes sense. What doesn't make sense is elected officials who ignore the people's will. This is a State issue. I encourage all Nevadans to contact their State Senators and Assembly Representatives to voice their strong support for voter ID.
Q. What is your stance on ballot harvesting and early and universal mail-in voting? -N.A. A. Currently the law in Nevada permits ballot harvesting and universal mail-in voting. Both provisions are ripe for abuse. This must be addressed at the State legislature. As a Nevadan, I advocate ending the practices. it should be easy to vote and impossible to cheat. Voter ID is the answer. Mail-in ballots should only be sent to voters with a specific reason to request one (such as service members serving overseas and people confined to home care or a care facility). Until the law is changed, Republicans must take advantage of these provisions legally. In the last election, I won the in-person voting by 20 points, but Titus won the ballot harvested/mail-in vote by 30 points. The Clark County Republican Party must organize the effort to get out the vote, including early voting and helping voters fill out and turn in their ballots.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: My Journey, My Story, My Vision
body:
I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
| |
---
| | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~ "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~ "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help- starting right now.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~ "I need your help – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/xSdFT2dBGnuComVl_NTm2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---
Nikki Haley
---

---

---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/pJAGjYdtGXcuIaww55QEwg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnVDG4P4RwAWh0dHBzOi8vc2VjdXJlLndpbnJlZC5jb20vdGVhbS1zdGFuZC1mb3ItYW1lcmljYS93aHktaW0tcnVubmluZy1mb290ZXItdHY_ "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/pJAGjYdtGXcuIaww55QEwg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnVDG4P4RwAWh0dHBzOi8vc2VjdXJlLndpbnJlZC5jb20vdGVhbS1zdGFuZC1mb3ItYW1lcmljYS93aHktaW0tcnVubmluZy1mb290ZXItdHY_ "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | ~ | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | ~ It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | ~ Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. ~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>" Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. ~ "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?" | | ~ Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, ~ "I need your help – starting right now. " Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | ~ Nikki Haley | | ~ | | | | | | ~~ "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | ~~ "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future. name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Big prayers from little children
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWgHOLCiN9

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWgHOLCiN9

Hello
Friend,

One of
the best things we can do for our children and grandchildren is
to teach, model, and encourage prayer in their lives. Kids need
to know that just as they can come to us "grown-ups" with
whatever is on their hearts and minds, they can also approach
their Heavenly Father and pour out their thoughts and feelings to
Him.

That's
the message of a brand-new children's book being offered by
Pathway to Victory called You Can Pray Big Things. I'm pleased to
announce the author of this beautiful hardcover book is my
daughter Julia (proud Dad moment!), and I can't wait for you to
see it.

You Can
Pray Big Things is a beautifully illustrated full-color 32-page
picture book that teaches children that there is nothing too big
or too small to bring before the Lord in prayer-from the anxiety
they feel about tomorrow's test at school to their desire to see
a loved one get better from their illness. You and I both know
that God cares immensely about every detail of their lives and
delights to hear from His children.

Engaging,
captivating, and chock-full of biblical truth, You Can Pray Big
Things is our gift to you when you donate today to the work God
is doing through Pathway to Victory. Your gift will be used to
pierce the darkness with the light of God's Word, as we broadcast
the truth of the Bible all over the globe.

Here's a
link where you can give to this important work and order your
copy of You Can Pray Big Things in time for Christmas
gift-giving: https://ptv.org/you-can-pray-big-things

If you
want to bless multiple children in your life, you can receive 4
copies of this uplifting book when you give a gift of $100 or
more.

When
asked why she wrote the book, Julia said, "My parents taught me
as a little girl that I could pray big things. This foundational
truth placed a dream in my heart and a prayer in my soul that
would-decades later-be the story of my own family. God is
faithful to do more than anything we can imagine. To every
parent, grandparent, and child who reads this book, may you be
inspired and encouraged that you, too, can pray big things!"

I know
that you and the children in your life are going to enjoy this
wonderful book together. Thank you, Friend, for your support of
Pathway to Victory.

God bless
you,
Dr.
Robert Jeffress

Friend,

Misleading corporate journalists don't stand a chance against Ron
DeSantis... and we've got the proof.

Watch Now

Can
you imagine a President who cares more about getting things done
for you than his image according to the media? This should help
with that visualization. You need to see this in action:
https://RonDeSantis.com/get-things-done

In
Freedom,

Team DeSantis

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

Contributions to Ron DeSantis for President are not deductible as
charitable contributions for federal income tax purposes.
Contributions from corporations, foreign nationals (without
"green cards"), federal government contractors, and national
banks are prohibited. Federal law requires us to use our best
efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address,

body:

---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Tell Congress to save 4 MILLION TONS of carbon emissions every year by passing the EFFECTIVE Food Procurement Act!**[_**Send your message now!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2178638?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) Many small and sustainable farmers are struggling to make ends meet. They are forced to compete with the**low-quality foods** produced by big multinational food corporations that fuel climate change and mistreat workers. It doesn’t help that the federal government purchases BILLIONS of dollars of food each year from bad actors like Tyson Foods. In fact, the U.S. Department of Agriculture spent nearly $250 MILLION dollars with Tyson Foods in one year despite its **27 SERIOUS VIOLATIONS of federal labor laws** in the past three years. The EFFECTIVE Food Procurement Act would transform federal food purchasing to reduce emissions, promote organic agriculture, and support small-scale producers. This bill will help promote **climate-friendly food** and support small, sustainable farms. **We need you to tell your Members of Congress to make sure it passes!** [_**Friend, tell Congress to ensure your taxes support sustainable food producers, not Big Ag corporations! Sign the petition now! >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2178639?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ***214 more signatures needed from your area*** | **[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2178640?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---
Imagine you’re a small farmer who prides yourself on regenerative farming techniques. You work hard to feed your community and honor the environment in the process. But you’re getting beat out by big corporate food producers creating low-quality food that is fueling the destruction of our environment. To make matters worse, _**your own hard-earned tax dollars are supporting your competitors.**_ This is reality for many farmers.
New guidelines for federal purchasing would help ensure our money is supporting emissions reductions, including by increasing low-carbon plant-based meals. In fact, this shift could **save the equivalent emissions of every car in Mississippi.**
[_**Will you send a message to Congress to pass the EFFECTIVE Food Procurement Act and slash emissions from federal food purchasing?**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2178641?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

## McCarthy to Retire from Congress
Rep. Kevin McCarthy, ousted from his role as House Speaker in October, said Wednesday he would [retire from Congress ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOhCAQQL8GO80wKGhBcQ3dXnulYXHQuUPYKFmzf3_Zq69_yXt5X7f55jlxXj_9TrbGMvtQ-UmzxNa0qOa-WWwkQlINWWlATsOotGw2i9N9gnEMEcykJ1Da-15pHQCNWkKIDVsEVBLBSAkgoTMDjSHKwcdxuatFiR5o4VqO7rtwrhvF9CpPOrpQ9ibZrdbHKdSHQCfQXdfVPUriyqG8AYEu03UKdG-LQCdRoAMt0P3Qk3O7h-CPur3ag05es69cchtKXg86zxZAKlDD1Bx2eVycEp_aiB7W3XP6C6j_7vgNAAD__5GeXyA)at the end of the year. He was first elected in 2006. His departure, coupled with the expulsion of Rep. George Santos this week, will shrink the [small GOP majority](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8Gd1iw2CYpKL7GXb72Sossi82FnwhQrLz9KVdfPdJoNF-37WZDDHn_bxOZ7stmsYcXbRK45qC2aXDGEwGpgYzUQl7ni1rkcBi8wiLJK_TzdSKEu9cOl0k4QOmFxiEYEKAkCC2lEFKMeqYLejlbf3F35RSbBLnQSx2_S8j9IB_f5UV1xJKGaI7en42pfwxWBut5niPmO34gg_WjZrBKYLCKhcHqS01UeXuSfVDlD3qFzBOirf148154pRb2zH0tiWPJe6XWuO38TbZyym48eopDNe55hhhDWzSbxJ5siL89_c87PwEAAP__ga1m6w) in the House, at least temporarily. McCarthy's California district is expected to re-elect a Republican. McCarthy doesn't [hide his hostility](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0MFutCAUBeCnwR0GuCK6YPHnb0y6mNl2aRAu421VJkg18_aNXXd3kpOcfDkft_HmaKHtcXcr2hLT6HyhA0epuOEKxqYKNiIqhAqtNEL2uoNWVrMNGnUPvXHRtROY0DcdOBW11n2rvGgrskookEoYKYWQojYaOx-ldrELEwRgjcBAJeX6M9FWZozLKx2Ya5_WarFzKc-dwT-mBqaG8zxrP-0bnvvVMzVckanhCw_a-Oq9y2V-8YyFMnLcAk-RB_S4Tpj5ReEz7SVl8jx97wXzNQwDbcVTYPD2__7OheBSOOdgqrINz5OWhfbWsEY8VkfLr6z8-dNPAAAA__9pUWkK) towards the eight Republicans who engineered the vote to oust him and says he plans to remain active behind the scenes in GOP politics.
## TV Legend Norman Lear Dies at 101
Norman Lear, the [legendary TV producer](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OqzAQRp_GdBPZM_y5cHEbutx2SzTgcZiVgQgsorz9Kltv9RWfdHR0vu7jnTXr9vjPq4SS9pHnopeMDqEDpLGuYkgiKFRJcJ11vumpddUSnJ_mllLkhqbJSvLeWx_nllqeuZ6mSgNaJIe2c85aZ29dI_2cXMOpjxNFMrWVqGU_bt-7bmWRlN_7Jcdt3tcqh6WU52non8HB4HDxoVLen8_g8CEbHMplcNjkdX5mP1beIAsfEIUjRJUTygVZHrJF4JxBNyiLQOJV8xscUtMjed8YHKojxOdLc9az7UxtHytr_jUpf3b5CQAA__8Oy2L8) responsible for "All in the Family," "The Jeffersons," "Maude," and many other shows, died Tuesday at the age of 101. Lear had a [huge influence on TV culture](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpDAQBb_GZEZ2GzAEBJc4m0svRD7cHnpl7JHpAfH3q9l48_dUpfr3WB6eEuXnX7_jzLEsfmU6cdEgrQSzdE2YIyKgaXDWVumpH82gm20Oq1ZWmdhZ28VB63X03TjZyfSTDXG0Dc2gwGhQVmultGptj-Made_jGP6bYESnMBCX2n4VyrxhTHc5sbZr2Zs0b8yvQ5g_ApwAd11X-z48l-Dvz0CAO7jUW4DDzFjZU94xswDHpwD3YQtwGgQ4NQhwudTdZ5nQVxkID-lTkpQlbyij3ynd8lVLeK9YJZ-S1pI_fztN1hiltADX1Dm8LkqJjsGKTj13T-nHln9t9x0AAP__waltrQ) through the 1970s and '80s, and he's credited with bringing real-world relevance to sitcoms, beginning with "All in the Family," which tackled topical and often controversial issues every week. Lear's shows were often ahead of their time. He parodied soap operas with "Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman" and talk shows with "Fernwood 2 Night." [Here's a look at his career through photos.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uwyAUQOGngQ2Le_ntwNDFW7p2tIi5xFTYWBil6ttX7Zz5SEf6Pm_LLZZajsdH3CmM3Ja4jvKkBVA4gWrRPIVMhKQ4BXAS3oxXFvgWTErOYIoepHWQViONslbne7IerCZeAkpUgNIBSAlycob8msHE7NNdJcW0pFRG69NXK8fYKNef9qQ-rW3nNWxjnBdT7wxnhvNJ7az0lxjOR-t7PESl2EUtmcQaO1EX5RDn1ka7hHEaUXveQzq_S63lso5p-dhjqf__8VL7GwAA__9f8lVT)
## AI Offers Jimmy Stewart's Voice
An AI-generated version of movie legend Jimmy Stewart will narrate bedtime stories for insomniacs on Calm, a sleep-aid and meditation app. A sample of the first one, "It's a Wonderful Sleep Story," [can be heard here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL3O4yAQAJ8Gd0Ts4r8UFNfQ5dorrQ0syUYQLBs58tuf8tVfPdJoNP9uy40ky_vxlwq7lupCocnBC6CeNNql76JLzMi2YweTgesw2xG6p-NkhvF-pZjC1aY-2BAJACj040iJ5k4cGrSAZgIwBsxlGngOCQZKc7zbaFVvOEqr2-VV5d2enPJZD94uoZYuu2dr667sH4VeoT9oE27nlyn0X7NCH-UhjbJC_-bPrtC_pJRT740_tDVNoo8qgfWdY5PCem91O3WgXDStqwa0www4j4NC320urh_JWfZxUr15FJL8k9J-HfM_AAD__-W_ZDQ). The app offers a variety of celebrity hosts reading their sleepy-time tales, but Stewart is its first famously soothing voice resurrected by AI. Calm used a company named Respeecher to recreate the voice. Calm is explicit that they have the approval of Stewart's family and estate and adhere to "high ethical standards" in recreating voices. The app is a subscription service for $6.99 a month; [learn how it works here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9ugzAQgPGnMdsh_wFMBg9d2NK1I3LMOVxqMLIvQXn7qp27f8On39d1vnpKtN8__YaOY559YHrhrDRY0GbumsVFRI2mQaesVJd-NINqVhcCBmnDZbwMqtNxsNZI77FHO5qbMmNDTkttlJZWKSmVbG2PY4iq93FcbmYxopO4EOfSPjLtvGJM7_zC0oa8NcmtzEcV5kPoSejpPM_2yOEbGRLt_NsIPQWftgqeoGAo6JnyDjmCD5wLPGjb3lAZT18YqMKKBeF4MrzzEzhDTYiH0FNT3HKclBLVwYpO3jdP6e-C_zX5CQAA__8fGGTf)

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=99b5d446f47c466385e6ddd7f4ac6663&_e=mb5Ld8oKHTSJCsLImW39STido5kA3-4k9WN5VH6JB6b2TvVQxnUBbdbApI0YhxfR_ofMjPXMwZLPeYB11ePjqoPu9d5-OR_23YbOooozyEfeoXc6Rx-RTenM1MBjdjoxfT4Of5wnf7q7qJZ2-MijKcEbtcxcUQ_BKclYnLESmQ6NmrbYegeU5ul0AkSVQfJIXFswAzVOybweB0hsaXxM5YQzAuXFPbYn4GIEh9CwbD9TyL-k0onCSD27BsxhSBeSOi4d1rMrVJkdKp7KGPnJckruut8nwNw78R40tOwMMSdkygfS4Ege0R721ppzv_nlUKjx8dQOXayRthuqnc2hpwsZttH3KN4gl4pRft7JzyfGHu7my-SM6lEe6dKSSpqGAHNR_OHgiCx7k_8LoaiKvvEp3_b2MPZcgkuvbNU0p0NjNaoxf5DHotAae5anvTOzxox4xJuYGWHo7EOdUifaANF_HL-xKc0R2vFdC07lE6mY2o5TrBj-GcJwSBuHabwOqoa_rLRCHWmkeXeoWxsIfGJwAygwEpvSXleQvevefAdpeWv1JOt2Ko6lbbWRD5xCo7qnwYs7N6xmJQnQZHBL8ltAvkXPsk-3pAY0AUy5QRQMrffJ10s-pr35f-9SErjojFSRa4hkT3HrphDTrKdeXg%3D%3D "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=99b5d446f47c466385e6ddd7f4ac6663&_e=mb5Ld8oKHTSJCsLImW39STido5kA3-4k9WN5VH6JB6b2TvVQxnUBbdbApI0YhxfR_ofMjPXMwZLPeYB11ePjqoPu9d5-OR_23YbOooozyEfeoXc6Rx-RTenM1MBjdjoxfT4Of5wnf7q7qJZ2-MijKcEbtcxcUQ_BKclYnLESmQ6NmrbYegeU5ul0AkSVQfJIXFswAzVOybweB0hsaXxM5YQzAuXFPbYn4GIEh9CwbD9TyL-k0onCSD27BsxhSBeSOi4d1rMrVJkdKp7KGPnJckruut8nwNw78R40tOwMMSdkygfS4Ege0R721ppzv_nlUKjx8dQOXayRthuqnc2hpwsZttH3KN4gl4pRft7JzyfGHu7my-SM6lEe6dKSSpqGAHNR_OHgiCx7k_8LoaiKvvEp3_b2MPZcgkuvbNU0p0NjNaoxf5DHotAae5anvTOzxox4xJuYGWHo7EOdUifaANF_HL-xKc0R2vFdC07lE6m4ecMRo4WAp8NLRx8cR28AyLgiZaSgGcC9oaVMuUHGo8dgzJqfQtAtrTJKbQyI-s3bfI2RPckSfK7mDZShXK6xDG-svI6VvNSAY0LHo9XA19y4IrSzrNB4kBWQLZtV1bodkWyghIq4HxmKbtD5JpFOaTA-NuES2kkkkkpRmBvp1Q%3D%3D)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=99b5d446f47c466385e6ddd7f4ac6663&_e=mb5Ld8oKHTSJCsLImW39STido5kA3-4k9WN5VH6JB6b2TvVQxnUBbdbApI0YhxfR_ofMjPXMwZLPeYB11ePjqoPu9d5-OR_23YbOooozyEfeoXc6Rx-RTenM1MBjdjoxfT4Of5wnf7q7qJZ2-MijKcEbtcxcUQ_BKclYnLESmQ6NmrbYegeU5ul0AkSVQfJIXFswAzVOybweB0hsaXxM5YQzAuXFPbYn4GIEh9CwbD9TyL-k0onCSD27BsxhSBeSOi4d1rMrVJkdKp7KGPnJckruut8nwNw78R40tOwMMSdkygfS4Ege0R721ppzv_nlUKjx8dQOXayRthuqnc2hpwsZttH3KN4gl4pRft7JzyfGHu7my-SM6lEe6dKSSpqGAHNR_OHgiCx7k_8LoaiKvvEp3_b2MPZcgkuvbNU0p0NjNaoxf5DHotAae5anvTOzxox4xJuYGWHo7EOdUifaANF_HL-xKc0R2vFdC07lE6nGkzEUYtmYbKvGAjK3nRpdaro6GlrarLncFJgAaj8ir46yos4lJtRQCemEgr0W_LJC7QsurN6stsKPRrelhd5hjQVmLo-4s5xVSw0nQxeu_wEugcCm1Xn2pRbnodmM768HpdmdLUt5snSrcT8LXQm5ctsYyXwZNqLzXl7YzN-UTA%3D%3D)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my FOURTH debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since the last debate! "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?" | | | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.
