On September 11, 2001, America suffered the deadliest terror attack in our history. It was a day that changed the world, changed our nation, and will forever live in infamy. Like so many Americans, I was deeply affected by those events, which led me to make a decision that would change the course of my life.

**In the wake of 9/11, I enlisted in the U.S. Air Force/Air National Guard, answering the call to serve our country and fight for freedom. **

For eight years, I proudly served in a USAF Combat Search and Rescue squadron, volunteering for two combat deployments to Afghanistan in support of Operation Enduring Freedom and the Global War on Terrorism.

I fought beside and witnessed the unwavering dedication of my brothers and sisters in arms - our brave servicemen and women who sacrificed so much for our freedoms. **Service is not merely a job; it is a way of life.**

clean_body: Today, I am officially announcing my campaign for Congress in Montana's Second Congressional District. | | | | | | Friend, My name is Troy Downing. I'm a husband, father, Combat Veteran, and proud conservative Patriot. "I officially announced my candidacy for Congress in Montana’s Second Congressional District. " | | On September 11, 2001, America suffered the deadliest terror attack in our history. It was a day that changed the world, changed our nation, and will forever live in infamy. Like so many Americans, I was deeply affected by those events, which led me to make a decision that would change the course of my life. In the wake of 9/11, I enlisted in the U.S. Air Force/Air National Guard, answering the call to serve our country and fight for freedom. For eight years, I proudly served in a USAF Combat Search and Rescue squadron, volunteering for two combat deployments to Afghanistan in support of Operation Enduring Freedom and the Global War on Terrorism. I fought beside and witnessed the unwavering dedication of my brothers and sisters in arms - our brave servicemen and women who sacrificed so much for our freedoms. Service is not merely a job; it is a way of life. | But times have changed, Friend. Far too many politicians have forgotten what their actual job in Washington is: to SERVE. I'm tired of watching politicians run for office to gain celebrity status, social media fame, book deals, and ego boosts. Too many politicians want to simply "be" in Congress, they have no interest in actually "doing" the work. I refuse to sit back and watch power-hungry Democrats collect a paycheck bigger than what most hard-working Americans will ever see. Our nation deserves leaders who have walked the walk and who understand the sacrifices our veterans make every day to keep our nation free. Service is in my blood. Dear Friends,

It's been a busy week and there is much more to come.

On Monday, I spoke at the Floyd County GOP meeting to a packed house. I was joined by my friends Delegate Marie March and US Senate candidate Chuck Smith.

The next day, I spoke at the Chesterfield VA Tea Party. Thank you again to our special guest speakers historians/teachers Ann McLean, Ted Lamb, and Anne Taydus, who led a discussion on the preservation of Virginia history, the history of public education in Virginia, and today's standards for teaching history in our commonwealth.

Coming up next week, there are two big events I want to share with you.

I'll be back in beautiful Southwest Virginia on Monday, December 11 for the Grayson County Republican Committee meeting, which will be at 6:30pm at the Freedom Center GOP HQ, located at 307 Main St. Independence, VA 24348. If you're in the area, please stop by.

Then on Saturday, December 16, I'll be in Abingdon from 11am to 1pm for a rally for Donald Trump's campaign for president. Please see the flyer below for more information.

I am an official surrogate for the Trump campaign. We are currently collecting signatures to get Mr. Trump on the ballot in Virginia. If you would like to sign the petition, [then please click here to submit your name](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00173NEXf3VfaWV_5PeCCHoU6Z5RSuVLUkWxMOJVH5SY_s-Y3pHphaJeoHtv5nul28y-pNarozJVze3e8BsxCQigsznu8Eniaopbovv1DxwnfI9SR-aqArjpOpvvsLXLXFa7vsOwOKJgtRKabuTJneauqgo5MAVt-vc&c=ujYFogaEuxQFFPXXh4I_Mq7wQDALqdZPeAtifZqchcfp_P0nX-f9mA==&ch=3mqPZEBIaN7RLS0PFzrDQAk3VidJcjW_wiNjbej0uJJMVG8gVtzF_A==).

For God & Country,
Amanda Chase

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ac46c06585be4209a0b34dd1b96e2f45&_e=h9A9tYRF1ygD19uvk_j9rxmgqjrI2LEWWONWLekd8YyYCw7RgVLxb67d6NPnc-cEbfd5-7H2iMnP_bB9cZRrg2dCaNhj4qh3A2nTJtKEOs2TdBmF2kzfnDDgbQ2X-0gD9W-x8wOaZ0INJHDBT6jrrRTAYK6jF6918Re_2O8-ij-YSqnnrTDj2oJ1y3S2URGBKzFWFIcBYOszLnDMd3mwFPGhmLHVMG-gNEEpUWMBYUHxXWuYiwnBDjFzeXX7etAuCAfX7nckwL2Y8nKGNXeby15Zgvkz5PHKrgHAy0QC3Q-0TE5q3HGpC_jOgao6XFmNn6JElHstxgcszhMDUWzyno8mGvH21EvnZux9MA_ptEPqsbd4y9arfRmpnwhL4jeZzm-VmB0oLjAITaAmJZqMX68ELVVROqj5IRdaRIova8AKVgZjg7Kq3B1G6zRo4EhapwhrVU-lbKOlzE5f2Mhw9SELyIXG3g_pCOBhgMUKO8inusDmB9ZDngqBIIyNy7QWYaEvrcNvmo_eE3W-pE-Lakc7RyH_orejWdqCre2OIzVPJODgEm-FU34rEelff6JkfYFT8RFeg-PgTY9qjvoa5qrcKH_Es_9ADLKER1BV3HUtYfIHdEaVKl1KxQ0wb6ms "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ac46c06585be4209a0b34dd1b96e2f45&_e=h9A9tYRF1ygD19uvk_j9rxmgqjrI2LEWWONWLekd8YyYCw7RgVLxb67d6NPnc-cEbfd5-7H2iMnP_bB9cZRrg2dCaNhj4qh3A2nTJtKEOs2TdBmF2kzfnDDgbQ2X-0gD9W-x8wOaZ0INJHDBT6jrrRTAYK6jF6918Re_2O8-ij-YSqnnrTDj2oJ1y3S2URGBKzFWFIcBYOszLnDMd3mwFPGhmLHVMG-gNEEpUWMBYUHxXWuYiwnBDjFzeXX7etAuCAfX7nckwL2Y8nKGNXeby15Zgvkz5PHKrgHAy0QC3Q-0TE5q3HGpC_jOgao6XFmNn6JElHstxgcszhMDUWzyno8mGvH21EvnZux9MA_ptEPqsbd4y9arfRmpnwhL4jeZzm-VmB0oLjAITaAmJZqMX68ELVVROqj5IRdaRIova8AKVgZjg7Kq3B1G6zRo4EhapwhrVU-lbKOlzE5f2Mhw9SELyIXG3g_pCOBhgMUKO8gsUxMXI5jOIlx3ca5uAn61KEtavky-jaGUIkX9yhQnVyKmTXxDkufd8muI6uF84WAom9INGMoHXfohj928EGseasPFXR1wtDsaz8GSZD86trKnHwfln0Tv4qeu6rJQkV_4DvYoEU_ytd9bfG4M_Z3e)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ac46c06585be4209a0b34dd1b96e2f45&_e=h9A9tYRF1ygD19uvk_j9rxmgqjrI2LEWWONWLekd8YyYCw7RgVLxb67d6NPnc-cEbfd5-7H2iMnP_bB9cZRrg2dCaNhj4qh3A2nTJtKEOs2TdBmF2kzfnDDgbQ2X-0gD9W-x8wOaZ0INJHDBT6jrrRTAYK6jF6918Re_2O8-ij-YSqnnrTDj2oJ1y3S2URGBKzFWFIcBYOszLnDMd3mwFPGhmLHVMG-gNEEpUWMBYUHxXWuYiwnBDjFzeXX7etAuCAfX7nckwL2Y8nKGNXeby15Zgvkz5PHKrgHAy0QC3Q-0TE5q3HGpC_jOgao6XFmNn6JElHstxgcszhMDUWzyno8mGvH21EvnZux9MA_ptEPqsbd4y9arfRmpnwhL4jeZzm-VmB0oLjAITaAmJZqMX68ELVVROqj5IRdaRIova8AKVgZjg7Kq3B1G6zRo4EhapwhrVU-lbKOlzE5f2Mhw9SELyIXG3g_pCOBhgMUKO8icTptw-nBxhu28-DgDJZHEuGyZxDbDgJWlD4-GPDe_zCC3SCq5eSIJrtg1w3W0P5fwTpcv9tivtsmpdCJkwqpppWFd_T51IvrB_50grXq-15IurVxjigvhT3VDNbuT1wtHbHbJ2NPptv7nY1y_chve)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ac46c06585be4209a0b34dd1b96e2f45&_e=h9A9tYRF1ygD19uvk_j9rxmgqjrI2LEWWONWLekd8YyYCw7RgVLxb67d6NPnc-cEbfd5-7H2iMnP_bB9cZRrg2dCaNhj4qh3A2nTJtKEOs2TdBmF2kzfnDDgbQ2X-0gD9W-x8wOaZ0INJHDBT6jrrRTAYK6jF6918Re_2O8-ij-YSqnnrTDj2oJ1y3S2URGBKzFWFIcBYOszLnDMd3mwFPGhmLHVMG-gNEEpUWMBYUHxXWuYiwnBDjFzeXX7etAuCAfX7nckwL2Y8nKGNXeby15Zgvkz5PHKrgHAy0QC3Q-0TE5q3HGpC_jOgao6XFmNn6JElHstxgcszhMDUWzyno8mGvH21EvnZux9MA_ptEPqsbd4y9arfRmpnwhL4jeZzm-VmB0oLjAITaAmJZqMX68ELVVROqj5IRdaRIova8AKVgZjg7Kq3B1G6zRo4EhapwhrVU-lbKOlzE5f2Mhw9SELyIXG3g_pCOBhgMUKO8jXzPyl9FWh1emr1yfY-MxAupKCI6pmMkd90MHKAeO3pNr57_2RtVLuWKIsfdA57KiWBfnxslemPpYS-wmXIM4BXewSR47fIeLvBnUDO9KRAoioVRgabnBKVV1O1GAgAW-k9N5XhltqWAbAiY1ovLRS)

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. Peter,
Eighty-two years ago, our nation was shaken to its core as the United States Naval Base at Pearl Harbor came under a surprise attack by the Imperial Japanese Navy. The devastating assault claimed the lives of over 2,400 Americans and left our Pacific Fleet in ruins. It was a moment that propelled us into a world war and tested the resilience and resolve of our great nation.

Today, on National Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day, we come together as a nation to pay tribute to the heroes who stood courageously in the face of adversity. We remember the servicemen and women who made the ultimate sacrifice, as well as the survivors who carried the scars, both mental and physical, throughout their lives. Their legacy is one of valor, patriotism, and a commitment to defending the freedoms we hold dear.

As your representative in Congress, I am committed to ensuring that the memory of Pearl Harbor remains etched in the fabric of our nation's history. It serves as a solemn reminder of the cost of freedom and the importance of remaining vigilant in the face of threats to our democracy.

Let us take a moment of silence on this day to honor those who gave their lives at Pearl Harbor and express our gratitude to the veterans who have served and continue to serve our nation. Their sacrifice will never be forgotten, and their spirit lives on in the continued strength and resilience of the United States of America.

May we always remember and honor the heroes of Pearl Harbor.

Sincerely,

clean_body: | | | | Peter, Eighty-two years ago, our nation was shaken to its core as the United States Naval Base at Pearl Harbor came under a surprise attack by the Imperial Japanese Navy. The devastating assault claimed the lives of over 2,400 Americans and left our Pacific Fleet in ruins. It was a moment that propelled us into a world war and tested the resilience and resolve of our great nation. Today, on National Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day, we come together as a nation to pay tribute to the heroes who stood courageously in the face of adversity. We remember the servicemen and women who made the ultimate sacrifice, as well as the survivors who carried the scars, both mental and physical, throughout their lives. Their legacy is one of valor, patriotism, and a commitment to defending the freedoms we hold dear. As your representative in Congress, I am committed to ensuring that the memory of Pearl Harbor remains etched in the fabric of our nation's history. It serves as a solemn reminder of the cost of freedom and the importance of remaining vigilant in the face of threats to our democracy. Let us take a moment of silence on this day to honor those who gave their lives at Pearl Harbor and express our gratitude to the veterans who have served and continue to serve our nation. Their sacrifice will never be forgotten, and their spirit lives on in the continued strength and resilience of the United States of America. May we always remember and honor the heroes of Pearl Harbor. Sincerely, Rep. **HERN URGES SUPPORT FOR DONALD J. TRUMP FOR PRESIDENT IN 2024**
**Washington, D.C. - **Following the fourth Republican Primary Debate in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, Congressman Kevin Hern endorsed Donald J. Trump for President.

"After last night's debate, two things are clear. One, futile exercises like last night's debate only serve to further divide our Republican Party and two, no one on that stage will be our Republican nominee," **said Hern.** "Division is the last thing we need - we need to rally behind our candidate for 2024 and we need to do it fast. The Democrats are already making excuses for their candidate, and their excuses are working because they're speaking with one voice."

"Despite a border catastrophe, record inflation, and weakness on the world stage, Joe Biden still poses a serious threat in 2024. It's unconscionable to me, but it's the truth. It's time to face the Democrats with a united front and rally behind Donald Trump," **Hern continued.** "Trump won all 77 counties in Oklahoma in 2016 and 2020, and we'll deliver all 77 counties again in 2024 in the primary and then in the general election as our nominee. I look forward to helping him beat Joe Biden and take back the White House."

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Join Me in Standing Up for Women’s Sports and American Values
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcbbcsfq83vhv7m4qg0v9q3f8bt2j4f6oof6jrmg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmco72chh2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z2hpadptpr9jo30n8dqqslo9egdok6l3bdg05u68_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmco72chh2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zr9kq3rhb147mppt30r5mr8nld103dfh0191q1io_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmco72chh2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zq9ef6isoo7m1tsu4s51hdievpr1m0h4dfm527og_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmco72chh2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

body:
I’m hosting a Bible drive fundraising campaign to put Bibles in the hands of public school children here in FL-12... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us16.campaign-archive.com/?e=00028e5542&u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=751a390235)
---
[**Help me donate Bibles to public school children this Christmas**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=54e1834c8a&e=00028e5542)
Good afternoon fellow conservative,
As you may know, the Bible was America’s very first public school textbook.
But today, the political left has our children reading anti-American, anti-Christian and even pornographic materials in our schools.
I’m running for Congress in Florida’s 12th Congressional District to restore America’s Christian, conservative values, and that starts with teaching our children about God.
That’s why I’m hosting a [**Bible drive fundraising campaign**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=c1cbeb52d0&e=00028e5542) to put Bibles in the hands of public school children here in FL-12, and eventually throughout Florida and the rest of the United States.
Here’s how it works:
For the first $25 donated to the Bible drive campaign, which runs through the month of December, we will donate two Bibles for public school students. Larger donations will result in more Bibles being donated to public school students:

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College has released an online course on what is perhaps Dickens’ most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge’s conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/christmas-carol](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._l25afZxOMB-WUxk87d7Gw)**

Let your family and friends know of this free online course as well. We hope it will add meaning and joy to your Christmas celebrations.

Best regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
It's time we had this talk.

|
---
| | |
Hi there, Friend.

It's Speaker Mike Johnson.

You probably hadn't heard much about me until just a few weeks ago. Since then, no doubt you've heard a lot about me- some of it true, most of it lies whipped up by the fake news media.

_**In any case, let me take this opportunity to formally introduce myself.**_

I was born and raised in Shreveport, LA, where I learned to be a humble servant of God from a young age.

Before being elected to Congress in 2016, I spent nearly two decades as a Constitutional lawyer, where I was a leading defender of the right to life, religious liberty, free speech, free market principles, the word of God, and our great Constitution.

I am, and continue to be, proud of all the work I have done to defend traditional values and preserve the American way of life up until this point. **But more than anything else in my life, I am a proud father to my four beautiful children and a loving husband to my wife, Kelly. **

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6t5g8jvee0b4ufn9pccj4g9qc60mbmlusvau4fo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmaor6cth2bs)
---
| | | [JOIN MY TEAM](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsojqtnjces3mrkej8qe4lpeji6cpqpgfv4iijtg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmaor6cth2bs "Generic Button")
---

Friend, America is in a tough spot right now, with no clear path forward.

_**Our way of life is under assault every day from the Radical Left and their anti-family, anti-God, and fundamentally anti-American agenda. **_

No one said it would be easy, but I need you to know one thing.
_**It is an honor and a privilege to serve as your Speaker of the House.**_
---
| | | [JOIN MY TEAM](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zu2is2edqivrbd4cdt68fddp9sr337uioadkjcc8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmaor6cth2bs "Generic Button")
---

The Democrat Party and the forces of immorality are on the march, which means we have a lot of work to do.

**[Will you join my team today as we fight to expand our majority in 2024 and return America to the values that made this country great?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2pcoue60t906c868v5061g9csb99s4n3m20lujg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmaor6cth2bs "Will you join my team today as we fight to expand our majority in 2024 and return America to the values that made this country great?")**

I look forward to working with you, Friend.

God Bless,

Speaker Mike Johnson

body:

Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za9seuioarg8rmjblbog7ohmjobs75rjfbmvlg1g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmeob6chh2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5mve427lek6egr11fo23tjhtjrfm6d6hf9lap90_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cjjmeob6chh2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

My ultimate question: Why is America accepting decline as a choice, when success is attainable?

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

body:
ICYMI: “Christie Gets His Groove Back” | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ff536d30ea43/what-they-are-saying-about-chris-christie-13560471?e=d0a9afa930)
---
|
---
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=8e3aecf46b&e=d0a9afa930)
|
---
**In Case You Missed It:

“Christie Gets His Groove Back”**
[Governor Larry Hogan](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=a83f2de955&e=d0a9afa930): “I think _**it was a good night for Chris Christie**_. I thought the highlight of the whole night was when he went after Ramaswamy, I thought that was strong. I liked when he stood up and defended Nikki Haley.”
[Frank Luntz](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=6e2990f971&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**They thought that Chris Christie won**_. And the reason why is that they felt that he was the most direct, he answered the questions honestly and candidly, and that he held other candidates’ feet to the fire. We’ve been waiting for this performance for some time. _**Chris Christie proved that he is not just a brilliant debater, but he knows how to hold other candidates accountable**_.”
[Adam Kinzinger](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ac3ea54b39&e=d0a9afa930): “This was Chris Christie’s night, I think. I mean,_**he was on fire from the very beginning**_ , he was telling the truth.”
[David Marcus, Fox News Columnist](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=d5f147a8b3&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Christie won this debate**_.”
[Scott Jennings, CNN Commentator](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=b0488f3c07&e=d0a9afa930): “Christie for the first time in the whole debate season - it seemed like he felt comfortable, maybe the smaller stage benefited him. For the audience he’s trying to appeal to in New Hampshire, his attitude tonight with that straight talk kind of thing, went after DeSantis a little bit on the Trump stuff, defended Haley, was funny there. _**He helped himself tonight**_.”
[David Urban, CNN Commentator](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=254899e179&e=d0a9afa930): “Governor Christie - he kept pointing out time and time again, ‘I’m the only one up here that didn’t put my hand up here that wouldn’t support Donald Trump if he was the nominee.’ He kept drawing distinctions, making the candidates answer the questions better than the moderators did. He was really forcing the issues. I think _**he did a great job tonight**_.”
[Chris Cuomo, News Nation](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=504012d198&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**I think this was the best night that Governor Chris Christie has had**_. I thought that he was communicating something that’s really important to Independent voters, which is, ‘I’m going to answer the question... I’ll give you a straight answer.’”
[Kaitlan Collins, CNN](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=bb99bc3d87&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Chris Christie also brought up a good point on China**_ which also made sense I think to voters who were in the audience and watching at home, which is, Haley has praised Trump’s policy on China, his trade policy and he asked her why she thought it was a good policy? Talking about the only thing that Trump really did on China was put the tariffs on Chinese goods that obviously raised prices on Americans.”
[Abby Phillip, CNN](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=741629d95d&e=d0a9afa930): “What kind of debate would this have been without Chris Christie on that stage? It feels to me like _**he really added a little special sauce to the conversation**_ , not just by putting Trump on the debate stage, but actually forcing some of these candidates to actually answer some questions.”
[Lindsey Granger, Journalist & Writer](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=46a8460a60&e=d0a9afa930): “DeSantis avoided answering the question and I think that was _**a really strong point for Chris Christie**_ , when he said, ‘look, I’m a regular guy, I can answer a question that’s asked, simply, yes or no.’”
[The Washington Examiner](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=c87afd9ca5&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Winners: Chris Christie**_ ”

* “But DeSantis was caught unawares by former New Jersey Gov. Chris Christie, who _**delivered a biting performance that at times got the better of all of his opponents.**_ Christie called out DeSantis for refusing to answer a question on Trump's mental fitness for office, with the Florida governor momentarily seeming at a loss for words.”

* “Christie wasn't called on for the first 17 minutes of the debate, a fact he was happy to call the moderators out on, then _**used his trademark aggressiveness and quick wit to turn in a memorable night**_.”

[The Washington Post](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ac75594c36&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Christie Goes On Offense**_ ”

* “After struggling to get words in during earlier debates,_**Christie established a clear role for himself in demanding accountability**_ from Trump, as well as the other candidates.”

* “In response to a question about restoring public confidence in federal law enforcement, _**Christie drew on his own experience**_ as a U.S. attorney and proposed appointing an independent, well-respected attorney general and keeping politics out of prosecutions — a striking contrast to Trump’s threats to respond to his prosecutions by turning federal power against his political opponents.

[CNN](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=4f416b188d&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Christie Gets His Groove Back**_ ”

* “In Tuscaloosa, _**the former New Jersey governor tapped back into some of that energy,**_ portraying his opponents as immature, annoying and not ready for the job.”

* “ _**Christie attempted to paint DeSantis as unwilling to answer basic questions**_. When DeSantis was asked if as president he would send US troops to Gaza to rescue American hostages held by Hamas, Christie jumped in. ‘When you’re president of the United States, you’re not gonna have a choice whether to answer that question or not,’ he said.”

* “ _**With Ramaswamy, Christie went after his tendency to backtrack on comments**_. During a back-and-forth in which Christie criticized the Ohio businessman’s proposal for a peace deal between Ukraine and Russia, the former New Jersey governor accused Ramaswamy of denying what he’s said on the campaign trail when he’s on the debate stage — and of being annoying.”

* “But _**only Christie made a sustained case against the former president**_ — a theme he returned to in his closing statement, when he said Trump wouldn’t be allowed to vote in the 2024 election because ‘he will be convicted of felonies before then.’”

[The Hill](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=422a14453b&e=d0a9afa930): ”The story of the Christie candidacy remains the same. The former prosecutor is a very skilled debater who can deliver more scathing one-liners than anyone else on the stage. _**Perhaps the most memorable on Wednesday was his contention that Ramaswamy was ‘the most obnoxious blowhard in America**_.’”
* “DeSantis’s performance wasn’t flawless. _**Christie made him look timorous**_ during an extended, heated exchange over whether Trump is fit to hold the nation’s highest office.”

[Matt Lewis, The Daily Beast](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=5e70873086&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Chris Christie Had His Best GOP Debate**_ ...”

* “ _**Christie arguably won the debate on points**_ ...”

* “... The ex-New Jersey governor _**held nothing back**_ against his rivals and the absent Trump.”

* “Similarly, this time around, _**Christie exposed DeSantis’ habit of giving rehearsed speeches while parrying direct questions**_. For example, after DeSantis dodged a question on whether the U.S. should send troops to rescue terrorists taken by hostages, Christie said, ‘This is the problem with the first three debates. Ron gets asked a question and he doesn’t answer.’ Then, when a moderator turned the tables and asked Christie his position on the subject, Christie quickly responded: ‘You’re damn right I’d send the American Army in to get our people back.’”

[Bryan Tyler Cohen, MSNBC](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=f68d600907&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**A Win**_ ”
* “Former New Jersey Gov. and current chief Trump antagonist _**Chris Christie took his three fellow debaters to task Wednesday night**_ with a succinct retort that cut through the bluster. “If you’re afraid to offend Donald Trump,” he said, “then what are you going to do when you’re sitting across from President Xi?”

[Noah Rothman, National Review](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ed4f7fe721&e=d0a9afa930): “If you aren’t inclined toward DeSantis, you had plenty to chew on, too. _**Chris Christie dissected him with the surgical acumen he once applied to Marco Rubio, savaging the governor for being evasive**_ — a charge DeSantis confirmed with his habitual evasions.”
* “[Christie] _**stripped the varnish off DeSantis and Ramaswamy, he shivved Haley**_ for dancing around Trump’s dominance in the race...”

[Audrey Fahlberg, National Review](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=303b4530c6&e=d0a9afa930): “After reserving his most impassioned attacks for the absent Donald Trump throughout the first three debates, _**Christie wore his heart on his sleeve**_ in Wednesday night’s contest, ripping into Ramaswamy over his ad hominem style and his insistence on questioning the ethical standards of his opponents while staying silent about Trump’s moral failings.”
[Jeffrey Blehar, National Review](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=75e32b43ca&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Chris Christie himself had a good night**_ ... With the field reduced to four and him no longer a 30-second afterthought on a seven-man stage, he had space to speak and occasionally dominate the conversation...”
[Kimbery Leonard, POLITICO](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=26c5305fc8&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Christie had the best night**_... But Christie managed to have some strong moments, even controlling the conversation at some turns — and putting his rivals in their place.”
[Adam Wren, POLITICO](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ec96a72789&e=d0a9afa930): “But _**Christie seemed to be the only candidate who knew what time it was**_ , and why the candidates were gathered here tonight. This is a GOP primary debate in which these candidates are arguably trying to win the race for first place, not second, and Christie was the only one who went after Trump. ‘They’re afraid to offend,’ Christie said of his three competitors. How is he wrong? He was booed in his closing statement, but he was the only one who truly assailed the frontrunner.”
* “ _**I was surprised by Christie**_ , still, being the only one willing to attack Trump in the debate. ‘I’m looking at my watch now. We’re 17 minutes into this debate, and except for your little speech in the beginning, we’ve had these three acting as if the race is between the four of us,’ he said.”

[Sarah Isgur, Political Commentator](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=a656fc8317&e=d0a9afa930): “ _**Actually answering the question? What an unexpected treat in a presidential debate. This was Christie at his very best**_. He shut down Ramaswamy, defended Haley and acknowledged the reality of Trump. Republican primary voters should embrace people willing to tell them the unpopular truth.”
[Daniel McCarthy, The American Conservative](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=76653474cf&e=d0a9afa930): “[Christie] embarrassed DeSantis by badgering him for dodging straight answers, and _**he came across as bolder and more distinct than Haley**_.”

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

As governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I’m going to cut right to it. [We need help in the way of financial support. ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD-f_tp0LnYwiJmkTTSeOimHwaKtz5Yh5TGCq2ThK0L3orDUD40nCOA44XzOtwv7s74838uuSvHhVoxtEq0TGPvIoVNr4njP6myN4CoiPQ9BWYjPK8lVAzgbf1u2ccz6_puUSvpRgqUUQJVVBryqXyRjyEu4zSUj1sUXIklNM18pdg/41x/dpNaUz7FTquFlxQU5tAQcw/h2/9i14efDbySNC7i5Hc9GVIBekdzwibEwMIcOx8zx4cJc)
If you’ve been a long time reader of our newsletter or follower of our work, you know I do not often ask for help. Please don’t misunderstand, we always need support and, thank God, we always seem to have enough. However, the stakes are now higher than they’ve ever been and it’s requiring that we ratchet up - fast. Here’s what’s happening:
**The Exciting News** \- We have lots of great work rolling out: the launch of our new website, with more trainings, resources, data, and direction; two new initiatives for volunteers focusing on voter outreach and registration; a critical national project related to voter roll accuracy and actionable steps to produce accountability in your local elections; the relaunch of our Latino counterpart ‘Voto Honesto’; a collaborative effort with [Intercessors for America](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/2inwxn55f_86YCDOz8IiKf10Jdu02OkzgS_JFf45OVOjsedhJxJPAgcXN9aE2SuUZ-n9y0e1qzSTfZLA_D-l_Z3LAXhi4HV6fDlDBWAl4sA7cfyrfymsTFcaE0MgMGfZQHHuICZijDGHBDrygMrVOW3ND_1eCwzT0buyL-DYHdu8kZs7iW6AXG16XvUq-V3q/41x/dpNaUz7FTquFlxQU5tAQcw/h3/luFmVxl9eyuh-9u-9bP6LveIHyVFUm0Fzq2kMPHQalw) to ensure everything we do is first and always covered in prayer; and continued front line support for citizens, legislators, and law enforcement. We have the materials, the tech, and the team, to execute on very exciting, worthwhile, impactful efforts that move the needle towards liberty.
**The Not So Exciting News** \- We are also embroiled in several lawsuits which have potential to reach the US Supreme Court. Though aimed at True the Vote, these suits will impact every American. These are must win battles because of what they represent - the freedom to speak, to petition, to assemble. Either we preserve the right to engage in election integrity or ... the alternative is bleak.
The Stacey Abrams/Marc Elias/Fair Fight lawsuit against us has already racked up over $1 million in legal fees. It’s political lawfare intended to divide our time and drain our resources. We must defend our case(s), but if we cannot raise more funding, we will not survive. It’s that simple.
So, I have to ask, and I’ll be asking repeatedly in the coming days, [please help us if you can.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD-f_tp0LnYwiJmkTTSeOimHwaKtz5Yh5TGCq2ThK0L3orDUD40nCOA44XzOtwv7s74838uuSvHhVoxtEq0TGPvIoVNr4njP6myN4CoiPQ9BWYjPK8lVAzgbf1u2ccz6_puUSvpRgqUUQJVVBryqXyRjyEu4zSUj1sUXIklNM18pdg/41x/dpNaUz7FTquFlxQU5tAQcw/h4/aCoYAoJ5lNndK7LcFlWVSM0TIZha11RYygO5G-js7G0)
**We Are Here For Such a Time** \- For over a decade we have been the tip of the spear for election integrity. Sometimes publicly _(like the movie ‘2000 Mules’)_ often behind the scenes (_like providing research to law enforcement or defending citizen litigants who could not otherwise afford a defense)_ our work has resulted in improved election processes at local, state, and national levels.
[When you support True the Vote, you are backing a battle-proven team of warriors.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD-f_tp0LnYwiJmkTTSeOimHwaKtz5Yh5TGCq2ThK0L3orDUD40nCOA44XzOtwv7s74838uuSvHhVoxtEq0TGPvIoVNr4njP6myN4CoiPQ9BWYjPK8lVAzgbf1u2ccz6_puUSvpRgqUUQJVVBryqXyRjyEu4zSUj1sUXIklNM18pdg/41x/dpNaUz7FTquFlxQU5tAQcw/h5/XsHEFX4C5XQytHWYCYdzMnTDjVtFqjUlDYcuv6W6Ao4) We take on fights others will not. We do not retreat, we do not surrender.
This email is being sent out to over 250,000 people. Usually about 35% of recipients will open the email. If you are reading this, you’re among that 35%. [Will you please consider contributing $20 or more to support our work?](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD-f_tp0LnYwiJmkTTSeOimHwaKtz5Yh5TGCq2ThK0L3orDUD40nCOA44XzOtwv7s74838uuSvHhVoxtEq0TGPvIoVNr4njP6myN4CoiPQ9BWYjPK8lVAzgbf1u2ccz6_puUSvpRgqUUQJVVBryqXyRjyEu4zSUj1sUXIklNM18pdg/41x/dpNaUz7FTquFlxQU5tAQcw/h6/V0_rZf01oNFBnFiDpa8vRADwGhlXj1vvS5hNj2ctWb0) I know not everyone can or will, but that kind of giving number would end our current crisis.
I don’t have to tell you we are fighting for the life of our country, you already know that. What I can tell you is that, here in the trenches, it is an every day, all out war. [Please help us if you can.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD-f_tp0LnYwiJmkTTSeOimHwaKtz5Yh5TGCq2ThK0L3orDUD40nCOA44XzOtwv7s74838uuSvHhVoxtEq0TGPvIoVNr4njP6myN4CoiPQ9BWYjPK8lVAzgbf1u2ccz6_puUSvpRgqUUQJVVBryqXyRjyEu4zSUj1sUXIklNM18pdg/41x/dpNaUz7FTquFlxQU5tAQcw/h7/aqdMewQYh85JRh5WileJ6tpu5gb9hy4HO6IMAmYLv88)

clean_body: A request for support from True the Vote | | | December 07, 2023 | | URGENT REQUEST: We need your help | | | | I’m going to cut right to it. If you’ve been a long time reader of our newsletter or follower of our work, you know I do not often ask for help. Please don’t misunderstand, we always need support and, thank God, we always seem to have enough. However, the stakes are now higher than they’ve ever been and it’s requiring that we ratchet up - fast. Here’s what’s happening: The Exciting News \- We have lots of great work rolling out: the launch of our new website, with more trainings, resources, data, and direction; two new initiatives for volunteers focusing on voter outreach and registration; a critical national project related to voter roll accuracy and actionable steps to produce accountability in your local elections; the relaunch of our Latino counterpart ‘Voto Honesto’; a collaborative effort with to ensure everything we do is first and always covered in prayer; and continued front line support for citizens, legislators, and law enforcement. We have the materials, the tech, and the team, to execute on very exciting, worthwhile, impactful efforts that move the needle towards liberty. The Not So Exciting News \- We are also embroiled in several lawsuits which have potential to reach the US Supreme Court. Though aimed at True the Vote, these suits will impact every American. These are must win battles because of what they represent - the freedom to speak, to petition, to assemble. Either we preserve the right to engage in election integrity or ... the alternative is bleak. The Stacey Abrams/Marc Elias/Fair Fight lawsuit against us has already racked up over $1 million in legal fees. It’s political lawfare intended to divide our time and drain our resources. We must defend our case(s), but if we cannot raise more funding, we will not survive. It’s that simple. So, I have to ask, and I’ll be asking repeatedly in the coming days, We Are Here For Such a Time \- For over a decade we have been the tip of the spear for election integrity. Sometimes publicly (like the movie ‘2000 Mules’) often behind the scenes (like providing research to law enforcement or defending citizen litigants who could not otherwise afford a defense) our work has resulted in improved election processes at local, state, and national levels. We take on fights others will not. We do not retreat, we do not surrender. This email is being sent out to over 250,000 people. Usually about 35% of recipients will open the email. If you are reading this, you’re among that 35%. I know not everyone can or will, but that kind of giving number would end our current crisis. I don’t have to tell you we are fighting for the life of our country, you already know that. What I can tell you is that, here in the trenches, it is an every day, all out war. Ever onward - | P.S. If you know of anyone who might also be inclined to support us, please forward this email to them. We are a 501c3 which means donations are fully tax deductible. Thank you so much for your consideration. | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- | Update your email preferences or unsubscribe (C) 2023 True the Vote PO Box 3109 #19128 Houston, Texas 77253-3109, United States of America

**Lt Gov Rutherford Endorses John Teichert for U.S. Senate**
**BALTIMORE, Md.** – Retired Air Force Brigadier General John Teichert received a major endorsement this week as former Maryland Lieutenant Governor Boyd Rutherford publicly backed the candidate’s bid for the U.S. Senate.
Former Lt. Governor Rutherford, who served in Larry Hogan’s administration, shared why he is choosing to endorse John Teichert for U.S. Senate, stating, "**General John Teichert embodies the principles of strong leadership, integrity, and dedication that our great nation deserves. His unwavering commitment to service, combined with a proven track record of effective leadership, uniquely qualifies him to represent the people of Maryland in the U.S. Senate. I am proud to endorse General Teichert and am confident that his strong character and strategic vision will bring about positive change for our state and country. Maryland deserves a leader of his caliber, and I wholeheartedly support his candidacy."**
Rutherford isn’t the only Hogan administration official to back Teichert’s bid for U.S. Senate, with former Secretary of Commerce Mike Gill also announcing his support. In a statement announcing his endorsement of Teichert’s candidacy, former Secretary Gill said in part, **“General John Teichert's call to service resonates with the spirit of the great state of Maryland. As I saw first hand when he commanded Joint Base Andrews, his leadership embodies passion, principle, inspiration, resilience and dedication, qualities our state deserves in the U.S. Senate. With confidence, I endorse General Teichert, knowing his strategic vision will forge a promising path for Maryland's future.”**
The endorsements by Boyd Rutherford and Mike Gill follow growing support for John Teichert’s candidacy. As the election approaches, Teichert remains focused on representing the interests and issues of Marylanders across the state by promoting his compelling message of leadership, not politics.

# David Tice,
President, Paul Revere Films
---
---
|
---
In this captivating episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani engages in an insightful conversation with David Tice, the President of Paul Revere Films. Prepare to be transported from Independence, Missouri to the vibrant energy of Texas as David unveils his unorthodox perspective on Wall Street and offers a behind-the-scenes glimpse into his illustrious journey through the movie industry. Delving into his current groundbreaking project, 'Grid Down, Power Up,' David reveals gripping insights about the vulnerabilities lurking within our electricity grid. As the episode draws to a close, he leaves us with invaluable advice: Embrace independent thinking, foster meaningful dialogues, and honor the wisdom of those who paved the way before us.
Please tune in via any of the links below, or if you'd prefer to watch the conversation, please visit mansharamani.substack.com for link to the video.
---
PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND!

Navigating Uncertainty is a show in which acclaimed global trend-watcher and futurist [Vikram Mansharamani](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZKs1JLj3OjtyfifM9ON4UQzt_8NKxM1dis_nSwZRIH7N0SfhaOdk_7tG9egqjGXd7-Am1_H8OLfjCoYBWtNLd7PniYq9O8kutCSbLoCjTTN98kHjwW-ZW9qI1LHLRKdMFP4XrBT3eFSDewkD3pMKKg==&c=Cf3tp1SRfyEvNUKGjMaHEgOADcmSV6ejDHpqroDBaUZ1Jp4AX-wMUQ==&ch=bvXQP49oq4DsRaCD_HjXnbuNyeEk3kue0D7_GSKu95kI-TeAUpSo1Q==) dives into how leaders make decisions. Co-pilots, one of the things I love most about December holidays is the spirit that seems to infect everyone. As Fred from _A Christmas Carol_ describes it: **"a good time, a kind, forgiving, charitable, pleasant time" of year.** In that charitable spirit, I want to encourage you to support a charity near and dear to my heart as a veteran – the Wounded Warrior Project (WWP). [Don't need to read another word? Chip in to Wounded Warrior Project here >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74743673/442518380/-1535374126?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzI1MGIzZi0xZTk1LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qKXrXlsodvzlxp2nl3NAMYXJuJI-oMgRb_hKtmmhwm8=&emci=848352d5-a893-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=ec250b3f-1e95-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=5643323) | [Donate to WWP](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74743675/442518383/-1535374126?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzI1MGIzZi0xZTk1LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qKXrXlsodvzlxp2nl3NAMYXJuJI-oMgRb_hKtmmhwm8=&emci=848352d5-a893-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=ec250b3f-1e95-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=5643323)
---
WWP is particularly meaningful to me because they were founded in 2003 as a grassroots effort to provide care and comfort to service members returning from the conflicts in Afghanistan and Iraq. **Their mission is to foster the most successful, well-adjusted generation of wounded service members in our nation's history.**
What they have undertaken is no small feat – it's estimated that over 53,000 service members were wounded in action during the Afghanistan and Iraq conflicts.
And that's not just physical injuries. For too long, veterans didn't even have a way to talk about the invisible wounds we experience like post traumatic stress, brain trauma, and depression.
Wounded Warrior Project provides service for the _whole_ veteran, not just one part of us. Their services include career and VA benefits counseling, physical wellness, mental wellness, and simply reminding us that we are not alone.
_**[So that is why, as you're celebrating the season of giving, I hope you'll join me by including Wounded Warrior Project in the list of places you donate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74743677/442518384/-784858050?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzI1MGIzZi0xZTk1LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qKXrXlsodvzlxp2nl3NAMYXJuJI-oMgRb_hKtmmhwm8=&emci=848352d5-a893-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=ec250b3f-1e95-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=5643323)**_
Thanks for reading and your generosity,
Ashley

name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA Faith
subject: Equip The Church With TPUSA Faith
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Friend

We're living in a pivotal time.

In many ways we are witnessing the dystopian nightmare of a
culture moving further from Jesus -- not closer to Jesus.

As believers in Biblical truth, we need to speak up to current
Western civilization and all of humanity!

To help equip Pastors and congregations to put our Christian
faith into action, TPUSA Faith hosts Freedom Night in America.
Through this monthly series, a guest speaker joins me to engage
in discussions around topics such as sexuality, gender, and
family life.

Freedom Night in America is on a mission to strengthen the
church and fight for liberty - which is God's idea, not man's
idea. Will you support our Freedom Night series with your gift of
$35, $50, $100, $250, or $500 today?

Support Freedom Night in America

God's Word is the ultimate truth.

But radicals who bow at the altar of "wokeism" disagree.

Gov. Gavin Newsome may soon sign legislation that would allow
the government to take children away from parents who oppose
their "gender transition."

Congregants at the Cathedral of Hope Protestant Church in
Dallas, TX were led in a prayer pledging allegiance to drag
queens and the LGBTQ+ movement. This is blasphemy.

But there is hope!

Thousands of American churches are aligned with TPUSA Faith's
mission to restore Biblical values, but they currently lack both
engagement and opportunities to make a positive political and
cultural change in our nation.

Your gift of $35 or more will support TPUSA Faith in securing
speakers for Freedom Night in America who stand for Biblical
truth and will empower Pastors and churches to put their faith
into action.

Christians founded this country, %FIRST%.

Fifty-five of the 56 signers of the Declaration of Independence
were Bible-believing, church-attending Christians. They applied
biblical principles and wisdom in the founding of our great
nation, and for nearly 250 years, our country has experienced the
blessings of liberty in abundance.

But today, those biblical principles are under constant attack
by decadent, humanistic, and amoral movements -- and if we don't
defend the foundational truths that have made our nation great,
we're going to reap the consequences.

As the inheritors of the Founding Fathers' vision, it's our
turn to own our faith and stand up for Biblical truth.

Resistance to tyranny is Biblical, and we must speak up!

With your generous support today, TPUSA Faith will continue
reaching, engaging, and equipping Christians to share their faith
and to be bold in the public arena on behalf of Biblical
principles.

Thank you for your support!

God bless you,

Charlie Kirk

Turning Point USA Faith

---
| | Dear Friends,

Earlier today, I was reading news coverage of last night’s Republican presidential debate and came across a report about Congressman Byron Donalds.

You may know that former President Donald J. Trump is sending Donalds to personally represent him at our holiday receptions on St. Thomas (6 p.m. Dec. 17) and St. Croix (6 p.m. Dec. 18).

Axios says Donalds is a leading contender to be Trump’s vice presidential running mate, if the former president is the presidential nominee in 2024.

That makes Donalds’ visit even exciting for several reasons.

Presidential candidates never paid us any attention. That changed this year.

The 2024 Virgin Islands caucus on February 8 makes us the third-overall Republican primary or caucus in 2024. Eight candidates, including Trump, filed and qualified for the ballot.

Ron DeSantis did a reception on St. Thomas with V.I. Senator Alma Francis Heyliger. Trump sent Dr. Ben Carson to speak to the last State Committee meeting. Nikki Haley dispatched her senior adviser.

Our leadership team is talking to the campaigns every few days. All of them say they will be here during the two-week period between New Hampshire’s primary and the Virgin Islands caucus.

Even if Donalds wasn’t coming here on behalf of the former president and unquestioned frontrunner for the 2024 Republican nomination, he is a member of Congress from the majority party who also serves on two powerful committees. In other words, he can actually do something about many of the huge issues facing our territory.

This is a unique opportunity to have the ear of a congressman, who switched parties from Democrat to Republican.

And his story of becoming a Republican is something that resonates in our islands, where most of our family, friends and neighbors are Democrats or vote Democrat.

**To meet Congressman Byron Donalds you need to RSVP. **Just reply to this email and I will send over the pertinent information.

And as Hanukkah begins, I send our Jewish members my warmest of wishes at a time when Jews everywhere are being targeted by the worst kind of evil. I truly hope that this year’s observation of Hanukkah will renew and strengthen the spirit of Jewish people here and throughout the world.

Onward,

Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley

You may know that former President Donald J. Trump is sending Donalds to personally represent him at our holiday receptions on St. Thomas (6 p.m. Dec. 17) and St. Croix (6 p.m. Dec. 18). Axios says Donalds is a leading contender to be Trump’s vice presidential running mate, if the former president is the presidential nominee in 2024. That makes Donalds’ visit even exciting for several reasons. Presidential candidates never paid us any attention. That changed this year. The 2024 Virgin Islands caucus on February 8 makes us the third-overall Republican primary or caucus in 2024. Eight candidates, including Trump, filed and qualified for the ballot. Ron DeSantis did a reception on St. Thomas with V.I. Senator Alma Francis Heyliger. Trump sent Dr. Ben Carson to speak to the last State Committee meeting. Nikki Haley dispatched her senior adviser. Our leadership team is talking to the campaigns every few days. All of them say they will be here during the two-week period between New Hampshire’s primary and the Virgin Islands caucus. Even if Donalds wasn’t coming here on behalf of the former president and unquestioned frontrunner for the 2024 Republican nomination, he is a member of Congress from the majority party who also serves on two powerful committees. In other words, he can actually do something about many of the huge issues facing our territory. This is a unique opportunity to have the ear of a congressman, who switched parties from Democrat to Republican. And his story of becoming a Republican is something that resonates in our islands, where most of our family, friends and neighbors are Democrats or vote Democrat. To meet Congressman Byron Donalds you need to RSVP. Just reply to this email and I will send over the pertinent information. And as Hanukkah begins, I send our Jewish members my warmest of wishes at a time when Jews everywhere are being targeted by the worst kind of evil. I truly hope that this year’s observation of Hanukkah will renew and strengthen the spirit of Jewish people here and throughout the world. Onward, Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley | | Paid for by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands. name: Wes Moore
subject: Sharing a few thoughts
body:
Friend, let me tell you some things that have been on my mind.

When I was elected to office, my goal has always been to be the best public servant that I can be. To govern with humility and grace.

Governing means showing up and putting in the work. It means working in partnership regardless of political party. If we’re going to create policies that benefit everyone, we have to earn support from everyone, not just Democrats.

That’s how our campaign won with the most individual votes in the history of Maryland, and it’s how we’ve managed to pass all 10 of our bills in last year’s legislative session with bipartisan support.

Service to others is the foundation that any public servant should have. But right now, it seems that some of our elected officials prefer to play political games rather than do what it takes to find real solutions for Americans.

To govern you need to be willing to show up, have hard conversations, and really get to know the people across the street. When I look at today’s political divisiveness, it’s clear to me that you can’t claim to love our country if you hate half of the people in it.

I’m not here to play games because our decisions make a real impact on the lives of our community members. I take that responsibility very seriously.

Our work for a better Maryland and a better country is more critical than ever. That’s why today, I’m asking for your support. The upcoming statewide political fundraising freeze is around the corner, and I want to make sure my team and I are prepared for the fights ahead. Please add in a donation today so we can make sure we’re in a good spot before the freeze begins in January. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231207-1?refcode=20231207]

Contribute » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231207?refcode-20231207]

Elevate,

Wes Moore

That’s why we need to stand together in this fight, but I need your support to keep our movement strong – and keep me in Congress, where I can keep pushing for widespread change.

This is our most important FEC report of the 2024 campaign yet, and our fundraising numbers will be closely compared with Boebert’s. It’s also our last opportunity to out-raise Lauren Boebert this year – purely with the help of grassroots donors like you – and shock everyone.

VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]

Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

subject: Remembering Pearl Harbor
body:

---
---
Friend,
December 7, 1941, is a day that lives in infamy.
Today, we invite you to join us in taking a moment to reflect on the bravery and sacrifice of those who lost their lives at Pearl Harbor 82 years ago today.
May we never forget the 2,403 Americans who showed us what it means to give everything for this nation, and our freedom.
---
---
---
---
With gratitude,
From the Desk of Bill Cassidy, M.D.

This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: My heart breaks for Las Vegas
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
The only thing that students at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas should have been worried about yesterday was studying for their final exams.
Instead, a day of studies turned into a day of terror when a shooter opened fire on campus—just hours after extreme members of the U.S. Senate blocked votes on key gun safety legislation.
I am heartbroken. I am devastated. I am angry. How many more innocent lives must be stolen until our elected officials decide that enough is enough?
My heart aches for the Las Vegas community—a city that is already all too familiar with the devastating impacts of gun violence. In 2017, we grieved alongside them when 60 people were killed and over 800 others wounded when a gunman opened fire at a music festival. Today, we must stand with them in mourning once again.
Our young people deserve so much better. That’s why I will not rest until we see a future where we can all live freely without the threat of gun violence.
Please, keep standing with me in this fight.
Sincerely,
Gabby Giffords
* * *

**GIFFORDS PAC works to end gun violence by empowering voters with information and supporting candidates who will fight for safer gun laws. A contribution to GIFFORDS PAC goes directly towards our work to save lives.**

body:
I know you expect us to take the fight directly to the Democrats and let the voters know who is responsible for the problems their policies created. | | | [ ](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=9482a6d5c4&e=6a281f566d)
