| | Dear Peter,

One of the advantages of servings as both Chairman of the Washington State Republican Party and an elected State Representative in Olympia, is having thorough experiences and analysis in every corner of our great state. Providing a clear understanding of the key issues facing Washingtonians - and the solutions needed to solve our shared challenges.

One disadvantage, in my capacity as legislator,**I am prohibited** from directly making any campaign fundraising asks during the legislative "freeze" period, **which starts this Saturday.**

_I am legally able to fundraise for the State Party_ during this period, and while there are other chairs who are also elected officials across the country who do so, I will not be. We all know **Democrats and sections of the** **media here in Washington State would love nothing more than to create a false scandal around their favorite conservative target, me.

_You will still be hearing from me_ -** our critical work at the WAGOP will still continue** full steam ahead **over the next couple months - there is plenty of information and action items that I will be updating you with as we move forward. Unfortunately, **this will be the last opportunity I have for the next few months to ask you personally to fund our vital work.**

**[_To help fill the fundraising gap from now until the end of the legislative session, will you click the button below and make a year-end contribution for $25, $50, or even $100 to our operations today?_](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=ce70328c73&e=6a281f566d)**

Please consider making it your very best contribution this year as we will need every ounce of grassroots activism during the 2024 Legislative session.
---
| [Make an end of year contribution to the Republican Party](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=bcd07e2a74&e=6a281f566d "Make an end of year contribution to the Republican Party")
---
| I know that might be a lot to ask during the holiday season, but **we must take the fight directly to the Democrats starting in January** and I know you expect us to do so.

You can already tell how scared the Democrats are by the six initiatives that are on pace to qualify for the 2024 legislative session.

Our GOP teams will be there at the beginning of session making sure voters know Democrats have these common-sense initiatives in hand, ready to pass into law. We will be there throughout the legislative session to remind voters that **Democrats are refusing** to pass these initiatives into law. And we will be there after the session ends to tell voters how**Democrats failed to act** \- and that not only will we pass these initiatives at the ballot box in November, but we will replace the Democrat legislators who failed to act.

Along with efforts to support common-sense initiatives signed by citizens, **the State Party will also have the task** of mobilizing grassroots conservatives to register opinions on bills, contact legislators who are on the wrong side of common-sense legislation, and once-again making sure voters across the state know Democrats are the ones responsible for the failures of our state.

**Without your vital support,** our teams cannot carry out this important work during the legislative session
---

---
|
---
| | Republicans in Washington State need to win the early battles in January if we want to win the close races in November. We will do it as aggressively as possible. And in doing so, **we will start winning again** come November 2024.

Please support our efforts today and let's head into 2024 united and ready to work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Jim Walsh
Chairman

subject: OUR border over Ukraine's
body:
No Ukraine funding until we secure our own border.

Peter- did you see the news from Washington?

Speaker Mike Johnson just drew a line in the sand and said Congress won't vote on Biden's Ukraine funding bill until Democrats approve "transformative" border security changes at our own southern border.

I absolutely agree.

Why should Congress allow Biden to send billions in taxpayer dollars to Ukraine while he completely abandons his constitutional duty to keep his own country safe and allowed our border to be completely overrun?
DONATE (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/border-security-contribute?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Ukraine_BorderV2&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=aa0f3f1093-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
You and I have both seen the stats.

The number of illegal immigrants entering our country has broken records. Hundreds of those apprehended are on terrorist watch lists, and that's just who we know about. Fentanyl smugglers and human traffickers cross over everyday.

Our border patrol desperately needs more resources. They need more personnel, more equipment, and more technology. They need us to fix our weak immigration laws. They need us to FINISH THE WALL.

This isn't hard. Our leaders have to start putting America First.

Securing our own border must be our top priority. If President Biden and the Democrats refuse to do it, then Republicans need to fight.

This is the kind of bold leadership I plan to fight for in Washington. If we don't have a secure border, we don't have a country.

This crisis is solvable...we just need to elect leaders who have what it takes to solve it and won't back down. (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/border-security-contribute?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Ukraine_BorderV2&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=aa0f3f1093-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

I hope I earn your vote,

Max Ukropina

subject: Don't rest on defending democracy in Georgia.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Georgia Blue PAC
body:
We can't rest - the stakes are too high.

Peter,

A recent New York Times article highlighted the electoral successes we’ve had in Georgia when we have the resources to share our message and compete throughout the state. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/11/24/us/politics/georgia-democrats-funds-2024-election.html?unlocked_article_code=1.Dk0.nD8q.X0L6vZkxdYYj&smid=url-share]

From helping send President Biden to the White House to electing two Democratic Senators, Georgia voters have had an overwhelming impact on the future of our country.
That same article cautions that an election off-year can drive an increase in apathy, but we can’t let that happen, Peter.

With so much at stake in the 2024 election, we cannot sleepwalk our way to the destruction of democracy. The radical GOP here is determined to enact its agenda - even twisting an order to make Georgia electoral districts more equitable into an attack on Democrats.

Georgia House Democrats understand the urgency, which is why we have a list of high-stakes policy priorities that we are pursuing relentlessly. [https://gahousedems.com/agenda/] We also support candidates who share those priorities. We are determined in this fight for our state, and we never back down.

It’s critical that we all stay informed and vigilant, which is why your Democratic representatives are always available [https://www.legis.ga.gov/members/house] to answer questions and talk about policy. But we also need your support to keep up the fight.

Give Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gahouse-grassroots2?refcode=120723_TheStakes_button1]

Let’s stay the course together. We can’t back off or fall prey to apathy. The stakes are just too high.

Onwards,

Georgia House Democrats

OUR AGENDA
Every day, we're fighting for a better Georgia for hard-working families like yours. To learn more, visit us here [https://gahousedems.com/agenda/?refcode=email-footer-agenda]

HEALTHCARE: We must expand Medicaid to keep our hospitals open and ensure every Georgian can see a doctor when they're sick.
GUN VIOLENCE: We can save lives by passing universal background checks, safe storage laws, and waiting periods.
CHOICE: We're fighting to overturn Georgia's six-week abortion ban and restore reproductive freedom to all Georgians.
EQUITY IN EDUCATION: WHe must invest in Georgia's teachers and fully fund every public school, regardless of zip code.

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gahouse-grassroots2?refcode=email-footer-cta]

body:
We can't wait on Congress to build our clean power grid
| | | | | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/339?t=2&akid=13898%2E53494%2EdtTVyx)
---
| | Hi, **We are on the path to decarbonizing our power sector, but the power grid itself is a threat to that transition.** To hit our goals, we need to build 17 times more transmission lines per year than our current pace.

Put more simply: **no transmission, no transition.**

To build all these transmission lines, we need to reform how those projects get permitted—and do so without allowing more fossil fuel projects to be permitted alongside clean energy. With permitting reform stalled in Congress, [we need President Biden and state leaders to take the wheel and steer us to the clean energy future our communities and climate demand](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5082?t=3&akid=13898%2E53494%2EdtTVyx). And we have good news: they have the power to permit a ton of clean energy and transmission without giving fossil fuels an inch.
---
[**WATCH OUR VIDEO + SHARE**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5084?t=5&akid=13898%2E53494%2EdtTVyx)
---
Our latest policy paper shares concrete steps the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, Department of Energy, permitting agencies, and state legislators can take today to make this transmission transition a reality. It'll require:
* Transmission planning
* Interconnection reform
* Community engagement and Tribal consultation
* State siting and permitting updates
* [And more](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5082?t=6&akid=13898%2E53494%2EdtTVyx)

It's time we shifted away from an outdated, fossil fuel-focused grid, and we can't wait on Congress to act. By taking the immediate steps we outline in our report, **the Biden administration can rapidly and equitably build out the clean energy grid, cut pollution in communities, and create more clean energy jobs. **
---
[SEE OUR VIDEO ON HOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5084?t=8&akid=13898%2E53494%2EdtTVyx)
---
Onward,

Charles Harper
Senior Policy Lead, Power SectorEvergreen Collaborative

body:
It's time we had this talk.

|
---
| | |
Hi there, Friend.

It's Speaker Mike Johnson.

You probably hadn't heard much about me until just a few weeks ago. Since then, no doubt you've heard a lot about me- some of it true, most of it lies whipped up by the fake news media.

_**In any case, let me take this opportunity to formally introduce myself.**_

I was born and raised in Shreveport, LA, where I learned to be a humble servant of God from a young age.

Before being elected to Congress in 2016, I spent nearly two decades as a Constitutional lawyer, where I was a leading defender of the right to life, religious liberty, free speech, free market principles, the word of God, and our great Constitution.

I am, and continue to be, proud of all the work I have done to defend traditional values and preserve the American way of life up until this point. **But more than anything else in my life, I am a proud father to my four beautiful children and a loving husband to my wife, Kelly. **

TOM KEAN, JR. -- Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of dedicated public service from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. -- Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people's lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. **National Republicans just confirmed that Mitch McConnell's handpicked candidate, Eric Hovde, will run against me in Wisconsin's Senate race — and he'll have their full support.**
The GOP has spent months recruiting Eric Hovde, who'll bring a virtually unlimited campaign war chest into this race. He has pledged to spend at least $20 million of his own personal fortune to attack me, buy this seat, and help Republicans pass their extreme agenda, including a national abortion ban.
**[Now, the secret's out-- Hovde will run, and I need your support more than ever to compete with his major cash advantage. Will you split an emergency donation to help me defeat the GOP's #1 pick in this race and defend our Democratic Senate majority? ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20231207-1?refcode=em20231207-1-8702&refcode2=8702_434096_ggMw8F&akid=8702%2E434096%2EggMw8F)**

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

Peter, I am excited to share this news with you:

**I am officially on the ballot! Earlier this week, I filed for candidacy in CA-27.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74758924/442550926/-233825198?refcode=em-12.7.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYjUxNTRjMi0zMDk1LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RvoYdxwy3SmjgVzhn-Xzvd0zEPHd5l_ruIJ9tc-Xg6o=)

body:
National Journal said our race is “one of the Democratic Party’s better offensive targets” in 2024. This is why:
#
Peter — I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat because I want to take back power from corrupt, control-obsessed elites like Josh Hawley and finally put real working people in charge of our country.
As a born-and-raised Missourian, 13-year Marine veteran, and economic justice advocate who watched my own community be torn apart by massive corporations, **I know what needs to change — and I’m not afraid to fight for it.**
Since launching this campaign back in January, we’ve built a powerful grassroots movement. We’ve outraised Josh Hawley’s campaign without taking a cent from corporate PACs. We’ve exposed Hawley’s creepy obsession with manhood and corrupt ties to the effort to ban abortion in all 50 states. And recently, multiple polls confirmed we’ve even already made this a margin-of-error race.
_National Journal_ said our Senate race is “one of the Democratic Party’s better offensive targets” in 2024. But now I need your help to make it happen.
**DC insiders and GOP mega-donors have spent millions this year to prop up Josh Hawley and tear down our grassroots movement.** Over the coming months, they’ll spend whatever it takes to keep their grip on this Senate seat and I’m sure they’ll come up with all sorts of desperate attacks about me and my campaign.
We need to be prepared to fight back at any moment. And we need to continue exposing Hawley and delivering our message directly to Missouri voters online, on the air, and on the ground. We can’t do any of that without your help, Peter. **So I’m asking:**
**[Will you add a donation of $10 or whatever amount you think is best to our grassroots campaign today? Your support will help us get our message in front of Missourians and, since I’m not taking a cent from corporate PACs, anything you can spare will have a huge impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39612?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39613?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=2&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39613?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=3&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39613?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=4&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39613?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=5&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39613?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=6&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39613?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=7&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39612?refcode=em20231207-4342&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=4342%2E614464%2EUQztI9)

And in elections since then, Missourians have voted overwhelmingly to reject an anti-union “Right-to-Work” law, raise the minimum wage, and expand Medicaid.
So in 2024, we’re going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.

# Here’s how we can keep
# our House Majority in 2024.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d4a1ebcc50&e=0a12281e0e)
Dear Fellow Conservative,
Do you like being a loser? Neither do I. But that’s exactly what Republicans will continue to be if we sit back and watch from the sidelines and don’t do anything.
Maryland’s 6th Congressional District is within our reach, and the 2024 elections present an incredible opportunity for us to keep our Republican House majority, take back control of our country, and save America.
Our seat here is an open seat for 2024 and very competitive!
But it’s going to take Republicans across the country to flip seats like Maryland 6th.
We're at a pivotal moment in our nation's history. The principles we stand for are being challenged, and it's up to us to stand tall and fight for what we believe in. But here's the truth: without your support, we're at a disadvantage.
Let's face it: no one likes being on the losing side. But that's exactly where we'll remain if we don't join forces and take action. Your contribution isn't just a donation—it's an investment in our shared values, our beliefs, and the future we want for our country.
By supporting our cause, you're not just backing a political party. You're empowering a movement that stands for fiscal responsibility, individual liberties, and a government that works for the people, not against them.Every dollar you contribute goes toward amplifying our message, reaching more voters, and ensuring that our conservative values are not only heard but acted upon.
Join us in turning the tide. Together, we can reshape the narrative and secure a future that aligns with our ideals. Your support is crucial in this fight.Don't like being a loser? Then stand with us, support us, and let's win this together.
Thank you for your unwavering support and commitment to our campaign for Congress.
Sincerely,
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d4242f198b&e=0a12281e0e)

# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=31483976ac&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e364b86ab5&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6ab017e4a9&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=71ae380723&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6db2a2b588&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=03b4bd4060&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2eebe31db5&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=63f8cf9970&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=08be818d66&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ddcfe4c7b8&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District

Hi there, Friend.

It's Speaker Mike Johnson.

You probably hadn't heard much about me until just a few weeks ago. Since then, no doubt you've heard a lot about me- some of it true, most of it lies whipped up by the fake news media.

_**In any case, let me take this opportunity to formally introduce myself.**_

I was born and raised in Shreveport, LA, where I learned to be a humble servant of God from a young age.

Before being elected to Congress in 2016, I spent nearly two decades as a Constitutional lawyer, where I was a leading defender of the right to life, religious liberty, free speech, free market principles, the word of God, and our great Constitution.

I am, and continue to be, proud of all the work I have done to defend traditional values and preserve the American way of life up until this point. **But more than anything else in my life, I am a proud father to my four beautiful children and a loving husband to my wife, Kelly. **

It's time we had this talk.

Hi there, Friend.

It's Speaker Mike Johnson.

You probably hadn't heard much about me until just a few weeks ago. Since then, no doubt you've heard a lot about me- some of it true, most of it lies whipped up by the fake news media.

_**In any case, let me take this opportunity to formally introduce myself.**_

I was born and raised in Shreveport, LA, where I learned to be a humble servant of God from a young age.

Before being elected to Congress in 2016, I spent nearly two decades as a Constitutional lawyer, where I was a leading defender of the right to life, religious liberty, free speech, free market principles, the word of God, and our great Constitution.

I am, and continue to be, proud of all the work I have done to defend traditional values and preserve the American way of life up until this point. **But more than anything else in my life, I am a proud father to my four beautiful children and a loving husband to my wife, Kelly. **

I am, and continue to be, proud of all the work I have done to defend traditional values and preserve the American way of life up until this point. clean_body: Cori’s always willing to call out the GOP’s strategy of wasting money on division and fear instead of bringing our communities together for healing. | | Peter, ** When Cori was elected to Congress, she promised to spend every day advocating for the people of our community and of our country, especially those who have been historically overlooked. That’s why she’s been speaking up and legislating for Black and brown communities, refugees, and the LGBTQ community, nonstop. And that’s why Cori’s always willing to call out the GOP’s strategy of wasting money on division and fear instead of bringing our communities together for healing. From championing the Equality Act to speaking up and defending our trans siblings from Republican attacks, Cori has shown up for the LGBTQ+ over and over again. With this anti-LGBTQ+ legislation being introduced in Missouri, families are not sure they will safely be able to stay in Missouri, and those with resources may join the wave of migration inside the U.S. as people flee anti-queer and anti-trans policies in GOP-led states. Clearly, we cannot accept this status quo and neither does Cori. That’s why she will continue to push for legislation like the Equality Act, which is desperately needed to protect those most on the margins. Cori doesn't take any money from corporate PACs, because our movement for transformative change should be people-powered. Right now we’re up against $100 million in SuperPAC money. name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: A step towards more accessible elections for years to come
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friend,

During the 2020 election I implemented Michigan’s first-ever online absentee ballot application. A historic number of eligible citizens used that portal to securely request their ballot and vote from home. As a result more people were able to exercise their right in Michigan to vote absentee, and we saw more citizens vote in 2020 than ever before.

I’m proud to say that last week that important policy became codified in law. Now, future secretary of states are mandated to provide an online absentee ballot request portal. That means future voters will always have the tools they need to conveniently exercise their constitutional right to vote from home.

It’s a huge step towards making our elections accessible for years to come. And with Michigan’s Governor and Lieutenant Governor out of the state, I was proud to be the one to sign the bill into law as Acting Governor of Michigan.

Both of my campaigns for Michigan Secretary of State centered around my commitment to accessible services, transparency, and democracy. When I asked for your support, and when I asked Michiganders for their votes, this is exactly what I wanted to be able to report back to you as a success. This is a win for democracy. And importantly, this kind of success is not because of just one person or one moment. It's a win brought about by all of our shared commitment to doing the hard work.

I am also especially grateful to Rep. Julie Rogers for sponsoring this legislation. And grateful to you, as always, for continuing to support our work to advance democracy in Michigan.

Onward,
Jocelyn

Both of my campaigns for Michigan Secretary of State centered around my commitment to accessible services, transparency, and democracy. When I asked for your support, and when I asked Michiganders for their votes, this is exactly what I wanted to be able to report back to you as a success. This is a win for democracy. And importantly, this kind of success is not because of just one person or one moment. It's a win brought about by all of our shared commitment to doing the hard work. I am also especially grateful to Rep. Julie Rogers for sponsoring this legislation. And grateful to you, as always, for continuing to support our work to advance democracy in Michigan. Onward, Jocelyn [] This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | | **For Immediate Release:** December 7, 2023
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**CALIFORNIA LABOR FEDERATION
BACKS DAVE MIN**
_By Organized Labor’s Largest Association
A Longtime Champion For Working Families, Min Is Endorsed _
**IRVINE, CA** — It's official: this past weekend, the California Labor Federation–the state’s arm of the AFL-CIO–voted to endorse Dave Min in the 47th Congressional District.

**“It is truly a privilege to serve the working people of Orange County as their representative in Sacramento,”** said State Senator Dave Min. **“I’m honored to know that the 2.1 million hardworking AFL-CIO members in California have my back, and I look forward to taking their fight to Washington, DC.”**

The California Labor Federation is made up of more than 1,200 unions, representing 2.1 million union members in manufacturing, retail, construction, hospitality, public sector, health care, entertainment and other industries, per their records. Their stated mission is to promote and defend the interests of working people and their families for the betterment of California’s communities.

This announcement continues State Senator Dave Min’s incredible momentum, as he has racked up a slew of major endorsements in the past few months, including from the California Democratic Party, Equality CA, the Southern California Armenian Democrats, NeverAgain CA, PORAC, UFCW, IBEW, OCEA, NUHW, the Laborers, the Carpenters, and a host of others. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions. Min received early endorsements from Rep. Katie Porter, the outgoing incumbent, as well as from Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the California Federation of Teachers, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=20f592299a&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

---
| | Hi, **We are on the path to decarbonizing our power sector, but the power grid itself is a threat to that transition.** To hit our goals, we need to build 17 times more transmission lines per year than our current pace.

Put more simply: **no transmission, no transition.**

To build all these transmission lines, we need to reform how those projects get permitted—and do so without allowing more fossil fuel projects to be permitted alongside clean energy. With permitting reform stalled in Congress, [we need President Biden and state leaders to take the wheel and steer us to the clean energy future our communities and climate demand](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5082?t=5&akid=13899%2E53494%2EdlLJg8). And we have good news: they have the power to permit a ton of clean energy and transmission without giving fossil fuels an inch.
---
[**WATCH OUR VIDEO + SHARE**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5085?t=7&akid=13899%2E53494%2EdlLJg8)
---
Our latest policy paper shares concrete steps the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, Department of Energy, permitting agencies, and state legislators can take today to make this transmission transition a reality. It'll require:
* Transmission planning
* Interconnection reform
* Community engagement and Tribal consultation
* State siting and permitting updates
* [And more](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5082?t=8&akid=13899%2E53494%2EdlLJg8)

It's time we shifted away from an outdated, fossil fuel-focused grid, and we can't wait on Congress to act. By taking the immediate steps we outline in our report, **the Biden administration can rapidly and equitably build out the clean energy grid, cut pollution in communities, and create more clean energy jobs. **
---
[SEE OUR VIDEO ON HOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5085?t=10&akid=13899%2E53494%2EdlLJg8)
---
Onward,

Charles Harper
Senior Policy Lead, Power SectorEvergreen Collaborative

body:
#
I’m reaching out today to tell you about my friend, Representative Becca Balint.
Becca ran for Congress in 2022 on a platform of courage and kindness because she believes that **when we turn towards one another, there’s nothing we can’t achieve**. She is an unrelenting advocate for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, investing in affordable housing, protecting our democracy, and rebuilding America’s middle class. Becca is also the first Jewish member of Congress to call for a ceasefire in the Middle East.
Becca’s political courage and fearless dedication to doing the right thing has already made her a target of right-wing vitriol and hate online. And with the 2024 elections right around the corner, **we need to come together as progressives and stand behind Becca.**
[If you’re with me, will you split a $5 contribution today between my campaign and Becca Balint?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231207-balint.kvaXqO&refcode=em20231207-5439-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5439%2E2526796%2EJNqWpa)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231207-balint.kvaXqO&refcode=em20231207-5439-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5439%2E2526796%2EJNqWpa)**
Becca is the first woman and openly LGBTQ+ member of Congress from Vermont, and in her first term alone, she has already earned a reputation for her political courage. Becca got into this fight because she believes we need more leaders who are willing to stand up for what is right, especially when the stakes are high.
But, as I know all too well, fighting for our progressive ideals does _not_ always make you popular with powerful people in Washington. There are already a lot of special interest groups preparing to spend millions of dollars to ensure that the people trying to change a broken status quo don’t get reelected.
**We need to stand with Becca against these attacks. I'm proud to call her a colleague and a friend.**
[Will you split a $5 contribution today between my campaign and Becca Balint?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231207-balint.kvaXqO&refcode=em20231207-5439-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5439%2E2526796%2EJNqWpa)

Yours in service,
Alexandria

subject: Moment to talk?
body:

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PJxoHugbCcsWdGJI98kPRw~~/AARclAA~-KHJlvkMwMFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~ "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PJxoHugbCcsWdGJI98kPRw~~/AARclAA~-KHJlvkMwMFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PJxoHugbCcsWdGJI98kPRw~~/AARclAA~-KHJlvkMwMFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PJxoHugbCcsWdGJI98kPRw~~/AARclAA~-KHJlvkMwMFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **FOURTH** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help us keep momentum STRONG!>>](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PJxoHugbCcsWdGJI98kPRw~~/AARclAA~-KHJlvkMwMFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since the last debate!

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Puw1kKXG0kRQmlywr2OKIw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnVMWcP4ReAWh0dHBzOi8vc2VjdXJlLndpbnJlZC5jb20vdGVhbS1zdGFuZC1mb3ItYW1lcmljYS93aHktaW0tcnVubmluZy1mb290ZXItdHY_ "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---

Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America’s future. | | | | | Friend, Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable.Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. | | When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Junk fees: we’ve all paid them. The service fee for your online concert ticket. The added charge for overhead bin space on flights. Overdraft and out-of-network ATM fees. The list goes on and on.

Junk fees cost Americans tens of billions of dollars each year. It’s time we put an end to them.

The Federal Trade Commission is considering a rule that would ban junk fees and give consumers peace of mind that the price they see is the price they’ll pay. Before this rule can be implemented, the FTC must collect public comments. Will you sign this petition and tell the FTC to ban Junk fees? Nobody should have to worry about hidden fees when they shop.

body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2181205?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **THIS IS URGENT, Friend! Manatees are dying out FAST and our oceans are being _DESTROYED_ by toxic waste.** One of the culprits? You got it – **Big Cruise.** Large cruise ships parade through our oceans and carelessly dump excessive waste into our fragile marine ecosystems. But the damage goes beyond that, Friend. Once toxic cruise waste enters our oceans, **harmful pollutants and toxins** contaminate the ocean floor and can destroy delicate aquatic plants, including _seagrass beds._ What makes seagrass unique? It is not only a critical food source for manatees, but seagrass also supports the vitality of our marine ecosystem. **It stores almost a FIFTH of the world’s ocean carbon.** We can thank seagrass for defending us from the impacts of our worsening climate crisis. The benefits of seagrass go beyond just our oceans. Nearby coastal communities rely on seagrass and its properties to maintain water quality which directly impacts their water and food supply. **Preserving seagrass is CRUCIAL to preserving our oceans for those who rely on it. Manatees, people, and our planet are all at risk of irreversible harm if we do not demand more accountability and regulation of Big Cruise from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. [_Please Friend, we need your help in fighting corporate greed. Will you take 30 seconds to sign our petition to demand the EPA to regulate cruise pollution before it’s too late? >>_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2181206?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2181207?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
With the depletion of seagrass, innocent manatees are left to **STARVE** and die of **MALNUTRITION.** Over the last 2 years, the manatee population has drastically declined. 2021 was the **_DEADLIEST_ year on record** with _**OVER A THOUSAND**_ of these gentle giants dying out.
Yet, despite the environmental significance of this critical marine plant, profit-driven cruise companies continue to increase ship traffic, size, and volume while carelessly churning up**toxic wastewater, sand, and other contaminants** in Florida’s waters and around the world.
Could you imagine what would happen if we no longer had our beloved manatees? Could you imagine the grave danger of our oceans and planet if seagrass continues to disappear? We don’t want to imagine that either, Friend. We can take action NOW to prevent this all from occurring. [_**If one out of every 5 people reading this email signs the petition, we can save our manatees, people, and the planet from destruction from corporate greed! >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2181208?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

clean_body: | = I’ve been waiting since January for the return of my absolute favorite time of the year: Hallmark’s Countdown to Christmas. While I don’t get as much time this holiday season to enjoy this oh-so-predictable movie-candy, I’m pained to admit that I have a soft spot in my heart for them. You’ve got the one with the town cookie decorating competition. Or that new one with Lacey Chabert (I swear she has one every year). Or the one with the holiday grump who bumps into an old friend that loves the holidays, converts the grump, and grows their heart three sizes. It’s silly, but a simple comfort I get this time of year. ## **Our Republic Needs You**.
On this Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day, our nation reflects on the sacrifices that were made for our freedom by the 2008 US Navy sailors, 218 US Army soldiers, 109 US Marines and 68 civilians who died on December 7, 1941 in the vicious surprise attack that caused us to enter World War II.

Now lately, we hear some say "what's the use" about running for office or serving in our government. The righteous anger towards corruption is palpable and real.

Some of our most treasured WWII national war hero figures are now [seen on camera weeping for the direction our country has taken](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=f71f71c400&e=5bb5efcda7) with its woke police state tyranny.

But I believe that the same spirit of truth and triumph that stirred up in the hearts of Americans on December 7, 1941 is alive today.

We are the Greatest Generation's offspring after all.

Please join us in reflecting upon this solemn day that "shall live in infamy" and stand with us in the fight for all that they died to preserve in this land, earth's last, best hope of freedom.

The unrestricted warfare for our lives, families and livelihoods is being waged by the far Left and uniparty today.
* Well-to-do and well-spoken moms arrested for exercising their First Amendment right to speak at their children's school board meetings opposing explicit sexual and child sexual abuse materials in their schools. No accountability.
* Peaceful public speakers for life and liberty raided at dawn with automatic weapons. No accountability.
* Leading Political candidate President Trump charged and sued by political opponents in office like in a Third World Banana Republic.
* Government FISA 702 back-door illegal spying on Americans without due process and in violation of the Fourth Amendment.

Our Republic needs us. Our Republic needs you.

In remembrance,

Friend, Integrity isn’t a dirty word. But some politicians certainly act like it is. My name is Mike Rogers. I’m a former FBI Special Agent, businessman, and Army veteran. 10 years ago, I decided to leave Congress and focus on my family... But since then Washington D.C. has gone down hill. Corruption is on the rise, and integrity is on the decline. After many prayerful conversations with my friends, family, and God I decided that it was time to rededicate my life to serving my country. **[That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Michigan.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=80a84b5f1ed947e8951ed5d0e0472136&_e=ZYpW95qjB12bWAF3BPfiahQWBdEA1RQ_9EYesLvVR_GOke_DdCCpdaCqVXcqgU6dfu1UUkmxlDozqZROMgSi-SONbR5QI8cQA-Ed2vdLU7PD_VxzOZDnDsOENO1dYQCQGERio0T7RftJ7aDqbftR73oJZS0XArsXSgPzHNzl0foQ9LSozWzs0wRk-rsgmyoz8vskTmoL4FexKxqvdQPgadUv1rMmXysR1Co--rYXsDGJjHx5iwKFNkQye_BHC9VGlW8TCUPOajCjAU4Xlw-FJbNfL2ANv03fQ3t5TF9eaqT4WfsTuJ4bILCz8n_9DRAeSGMsZpBayIeRucbeLba0XPauhfURQx5aYWlmhaSG7Ds9FluJSl1GSv3JP7a-PWv4SvH79low3JyhX5IM0h4hS5Fm6PRRcSZhmTLm2bNzX_Y%3D)** To say that Washington has problems is the understatement of the century. Politicians who don’t care about their constituents, policies that have given us crushing inflation and open borders, and a complete lack of accountability for anyone involved have led me to say **ENOUGH IS ENOUGH.** In 2024, we have the chance to end corruption, restore integrity, secure our borders, and stop reckless spending. But none of that's possible unless we deliver a decisive win in my home state of Michigan. You know it as well as I do. Michigan was the swing state that delivered President Trump’s victory in 2016. And in 2020, Michigan helped to deliver a majority for Senate Democrats. Now, in 2024... **_If we win Michigan’s Senate race Republicans will hold the reins again._** Friend, Michigan is the ONLY competitive seat in the country without an incumbent in the race. That means we have all the ingredients necessary to pull off a major victory. But only if we have the support of patriots like you. I’m running for U.S. Senate to RESTORE INTEGRITY to Washington D.C. and deliver a decisive blow to the radical left’s agenda. **[Can I count on your support to help me do just that?](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=80a84b5f1ed947e8951ed5d0e0472136&_e=ZYpW95qjB12bWAF3BPfiahQWBdEA1RQ_9EYesLvVR_GOke_DdCCpdaCqVXcqgU6dfu1UUkmxlDozqZROMgSi-SONbR5QI8cQA-Ed2vdLU7PD_VxzOZDnDsOENO1dYQCQGERio0T7RftJ7aDqbftR73oJZS0XArsXSgPzHNzl0foQ9LSozWzs0wRk-rsgmyoz8vskTmoL4FexKxqvdQPgadUv1rMmXysR1Co--rYXsDGJjHx5iwKFNkQye_BHC9VGlW8TCUPOajCjAU4Xlw-FJWxsPww69WPYYxTUskyhAAvpoYwt0Kua91mDk4L9BuOEz9u5vB55Aft3b3MdulAs84T5KFkxD5TLSv_jljjR1ffPiDnhTyhW8GD-kk0FEjGdsiJ3eNkqnLGAvHDOJDynHsWvez5z-DAYjPi8GBH1aww%3D)** I’ll be straight with you — this campaign is going to be expensive and it’s going to take EVERYONE pitching in to win. Truly, thank you for your consideration. **_I hope I can count on you, Friend._** Sincerely,

| The only way we are going to move forward as a country is by unifying around our shared values.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4688%2E5257348%2ELdN81f)
Derek —
Kevin McCarthy, the former Speaker of the House and one of my main antagonists in the Congress, announced in a _Wall Street Journal_ op-ed that he is resigning.
After fifteen humiliating votes to scrape and claw his way to the Speaker’s gavel, McCarthy immediately used his political capital to attack me — removing me from the Intelligence Committee. Vowing to the California Republican Party convention that I could “never” become California’s senator. Leading my censure under the personal threat of Donald Trump.
**But I’m still standing, and he's the one who lost the faith of his caucus and is now leaving Congress.**
I could go on for a _long_ time about why McCarthy’s departure from the House is no loss to the state or country.
But here’s what I’m thinking about today:
**McCarthy is all too symbolic of a Republican leadership that has no real ideology except the pursuit of power and will tie itself into knots trying to please Donald Trump in order to acquire power and hold onto it.**
The MAGA movement is now willing to eviscerate the civil service, mobilize the military domestically, weaponize the justice department to go after political opponents, and terminate the Constitution if they lose the next election. These are all positions their party leader has articulated, and they are still devoted to him.
**The only way we are going to move forward as a country is by defeating this anti-democratic cult of personality and fighting for our democracy and an economy that works for everyone.**
And Derek, with 90 days until our primary, we need to engage right now, as the MAGA crowd tries to stop me from reaching the Senate.
McCarthy will have a lot of time — and money — to meddle in our race in the homestretch to fulfill his promise that I can never be California's senator. We cannot — and will not — let his brand of politics win.

subject: Who Don’t You TRUST?

body:
|
---
Who Don’t You _**TRUST**_?

Above all, the people of the 10th District need a representative in Congress they can _**TRUST**_ to bring their priorities and values to the table. Only 8% of the American people have confidence in Congress today, down from 42% fifty years ago.

Scott Perry and the Chaos Caucus have a lot to do with that. Can we trust Scott Perry to:
* Defend democracy and voting rights in America and around the world? Nope.
* Uphold his oath of office? Nope.
* Guarantee reproductive freedom for women? Nope.
* Reduce gun violence and promote gun safety? Nope.
* Ensure financial security for seniors and ordinary citizens? Nope.
* Enforce the law against wealthy tax cheats? Nope.
* Protect our planet for future generations? Nope.
* Treat ALL people with dignity and respect? Nope.
* Expand health care and cut poverty? Nope.
* Inspire confidence in our government by the international financial community? Nope.
* Control inflation? Nope.

What are your priorities? Chances are Scott Perry has done NOTHING to advance them. Pardon-me Perry’s entire focus has been on promoting dictatorship, fighting irrelevant culture wars, and saving himself from prison.

I write this to you today with a heavy heart. We are in a critical moment for our democracy, and what we do right now will determine the future of this nation. My name is Alia Kapasi — and I’m Kirsten’s 2024 campaign manager.

| Hi there, How many times have you heard someone say - “I don't like to get political" as a polite way to get out of a controversial topic of conversation? Politics has never been polite dinner table conversation, and even more so now that our political environment is more bitter and divisive than ever before. But the reality is that politics impacts people's everyday lives whether we "get political" or not, from whether families can afford lifesaving medication for their children to which communities get funding for transportation projects, to our very rights and freedoms to exist in a democratic society. Politics is personal. The problem isn't politics itself but how we choose TO DO politics. I decided to get into politics because I knew we needed people willing to lower the temperature, find common ground, and build consensus around issues that matter. And that's what I'm doing every day. I'm undeterred when someone tries to stir the pot or cause division for the sake of division. I remain focused on what matters, with a steady hand on the wheel and a calm demeanor. Hello friends!
We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well.
Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, career opportunities, and other resources as we get ready to turn our attention to 2024.
NPP Excited to Announce Three Promotions!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/Untitled%20design_5.png]
Please join us in congratulating three of our staff members -- Chief Operating Officer Stephanie Frank, Chief Financial Officer James Latta, and Director of Campaigns & Engagement Dyneco Gibson -- on their new roles with the New Pennsylvania Project!
Stephanie's dedication to democracy in the commonwealth comes from a combination of deep generational PA roots and over a decade of fighting for systemic policy change at the state government level, forming the belief that positive change comes from the ground up.
James is passionate about building effective, impactful, and sustainable organizations that can do this important work, year after year.
Dyneco believes this work is important to her because she wants her teenage daughter to know that as a minority woman, her voice is important. And, for her to remember that African Americans and women did not always have the right to vote.
Congratulations to James, Stephanie, and Dyneco -- we're so excited to watch you excel in your new roles!
What Issues Matter To You?
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/NPP%20Social_6.jpg]
As the New Pennsylvania Project gears up for the 2024 election cycle, we want to hear from voters across the Commonwealth about issues that impact you and if you will vote in both April's primary and November's general election. Your responses will help us focus on the issues that matter to you and allow us to reach new voters ahead of these crucially important elections! Click the button below to take this quick two minute survey.
Click Here To Take Survey [https://www.newpaproject.org/poll-2024/]
NPP in the News
WATCH: Black Robes, Gold Credentials: Building an Equal Justice Federal Judiciary [https://www.youtube.com/live/alwIs7okJF8?feature=shared]
(1Hood Power)
Did you miss our "Black Robes, Gold Credentials: Building an Equal Justice Federal Judiciary" panel with The Leadership Conference on Civil & Human Rights and 1Hood Power? Click the link above to check out a video recording of the conversation that touched on issues like he historic number of highly qualified and diverse judges recently confirmed by our senators, remaining judicial vacancies in Pennsylvania, and the ongoing need for judicial ethics reform.
Get Out The Vote Round-Up [https://unerasedbws.com/get-out-the-vote-round-up/]
(Black Women Speak)
NPP CEO Kadida Kenner took part in a video presentation as part of Black Women Speak's Unerased initiative where she discussed our organization, as well as, how to best engaged those in your network to get out and vote.
Instagram of the Week
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/IMG_0224.jpg]
Tonight marks the first night of Hanukkah and the New Pennsylvania Project would like to extend a hearty chag sameach to all those in our community who will be celebrating! May this festival of lights bring blessings upon you and your family!
News You Can Use
Eclipsed in his Era, Bayard Rustin Gets to Shine in Ours [https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2023/11/13/eclipsed-in-his-era-bayard-rustin-gets-to-shine-in-ours]
(The New Yorker)
Bayard Rustin has emerged of late as a hero almost perfectly tuned to our time. A Black civil-rights leader who was an architect of the 1963 March on Washington, he was also, in an aptly intersectional way, a gay man who suffered for his gayness—suffered in the homophobic America of the nineteen-forties and fifties, of course, but also within the homo-suspicious civil-rights movement of the sixties. A peerless manager and mentor, Rustin had still done more, and harder, prison time than almost any of the other great leaders of the movement.
Michigan is first state to automatically register ex-prisoners to vote [https://www.mlive.com/politics/2023/12/michigan-is-first-state-to-automatically-register-ex-prisoners-to-vote.html]
(Mlive)
Michigan on Thursday became the first U.S. state to automatically register people to vote when they are released from prison, part of a slew of new election laws that also affect artificial intelligence, harassment and young voters.
Judge nixes minimum wage hike for Allegheny County workers [https://triblive.com/local/judge-nixes-minimum-wage-hike-for-allegheny-county-workers/]
(Penn Capital-Star)
An effort to establish and increase a minimum wage up to $20 an hour for Allegheny County employees was ruled invalid by a judge this week. The bill was challenged by Allegheny County Executive Rich Fitzgerald after it was passed over his veto. Fitzgerald said when he filed an action for declaratory judgment this summer that while he supports wage increases in general, he believed county council did not have the legal authority to create and increase county employees’ wages. #CourtsMatter

body:
The GOP is playing political games while our friends dodge bullets.
#
Derek - it’s Alex Vindman.
Making sure you saw the email VoteVets sent yesterday. I’m furious that, at such a critical time, the GOP is blocking aid for Ukraine.
I’ve spoken to colleagues at home and abroad. This aid package is life or death for the people of Ukraine. If it fails to pass, make no mistake: The GOP will have blood on their hands.
The Ukrainians have fought Putin to a standstill and continue to liberate their country, piece by piece, against all odds. But Republicans in the House and Senate seem determined to put their own political machinations first. Republicans are helping Putin gain advantage over Ukraine.
That has major implications — not just for Ukraine, not just for Europe, but for all of us. Most of all, our Troops. A resurgent Putin is a threat to democracy everywhere, and he will not stop at Ukraine. Ukraine’s defeat would invite aggression even against NATO territory. And then our Troops will be sent in.
But VoteVets is pushing back. If any organization can pressure the GOP into action, it’s them. They killed Tuberville’s blockade. They got the PACT Act across the finish line. They’ve stopped more assaults on the VA than I can count.
So if you can, please: **[Make a donation and support VoteVets as they take the fight to the GOP over this Ukraine aid package.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-dec23-waiting.mfIbUF&refcode=em231207-1-30&t=1&akid=21293%2E3013755%2EpWWRGm)**

Thanks,
-Alex
* * *

More than 400 officers are taking their leadership positions now that we forced Tommy Tuberville and the GOP to stand down and unfreeze their promotions.
But fresh off of one manufactured crisis, the GOP is ready to push us into another.
The people of Ukraine are fighting off a murderous dictator. They are holding the line for democracy — not just in their country, but for all of Europe. America has supported Ukraine every step of the way.
Until now.
**[Watch our new video, “Waiting,” and then contribute to help us eviscerate the GOP for politicizing aid for Ukraine.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-dec23-waiting.mfIbUF&refcode=em231207-1-30&t=3&akid=21293%2E3013755%2EpWWRGm)

Republicans in the House and Senate have held up critical aid for Ukraine.
The GOP is playing political games while our friends dodge bullets.
The American people still support Ukraine. Victory in Ukraine is still critical to our National Security and critical to ending Putin’s expansionist aims. And our aid has never been more important to them than it is now.
But the Republican Party, from the top down, is worse than AWOL — they’re actively opposing it.
We **_will**_ hold the GOP accountable for this, and VoteVets gets results.
