---
| | | | | | | | | | Please see a message from our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe, click [**here**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_t=iqOh-8w_ImoJJb7W9S3mNLUv6W1vFwL4yxEU1wEaQiTrlDO6U2kMN1i-XRXmw9g3BzciJ0zMrYzdzi5yZj_7S84uqGG0USMIJLL1UTbZw5w%3D)
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_e=b5RXqm5YoX6d80sJGI6UnSF9RjENRoaqZMHtFl74-Ll_KTWkYbqDDDr8hkv_heTnVdugt5OVkrbuzX4qM8voX9UoMA51hK1393wIH7_JPA_NVgGLKB17g30ztnffuhQWJB1WRAn_EZfDS_hg96xaPkV_v7v8tbEgZSNyyJbq7cq3dHWCv-ZoB2fO6n2Jnrr3VHyy4lXKmg5JJpSSliIoj6rhW_fxX7DlWiXmE46yTKeQk55DFOcw4fE9nN8XMC7pdo4Gp5PSQZaNVZ4qxkRlYdLglWYHg4jJl7AwZjXHzKtLRTCSIgCgJj-15NtHdMUio3LrYJ2pTWj0VtLgCOffOYyKhwELMjXKmMjXN7i5LQ-txSTZavq94Utoh_MuZNrM92t9wLREsgpGZa5NGbOSVnILfN9ADpiYX-bsCfTIeSY%3D)
Peter, The fourth Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_e=b5RXqm5YoX6d80sJGI6UnSF9RjENRoaqZMHtFl74-Ll_KTWkYbqDDDr8hkv_heTnVdugt5OVkrbuzX4qM8voX9UoMA51hK1393wIH7_JPA_NVgGLKB17g30ztnffuhQWJB1WRAn_EZfDS_hg96xaPkV_v7v8tbEgZSNyyJbq7cq3dHWCv-ZoB2fO6n2Jnrr3VHyy4lXKmg5JJpSSliIoj6rhW_fxX7DlWiXmE46yTKeQk55DFOcw4fE9nN8XMC7pGYQerKoZMlFXp4efyg_nhz-CJiDv3jNjePpGAnB55voYHNOLcxzm1A124-_CueG6M7xrtJDm0cYAJbxw9RiyF1rOLUdKxKE6R61MLf80lgk_Vr0GdCFl8e6_1dRvj0ToMAQLS6xyakGS5i9mhMKxRrMEUJpxe1ucNPvHOGn0os8%3D)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_e=b5RXqm5YoX6d80sJGI6UnSF9RjENRoaqZMHtFl74-Ll_KTWkYbqDDDr8hkv_heTnVdugt5OVkrbuzX4qM8voX9UoMA51hK1393wIH7_JPA_NVgGLKB17g30ztnffuhQWJB1WRAn_EZfDS_hg96xaPkV_v7v8tbEgZSNyyJbq7cq3dHWCv-ZoB2fO6n2Jnrr3VHyy4lXKmg5JJpSSliIoj6rhW_fxX7DlWiXmE46yTKeQk55DFOcw4fE9nN8XMC7pMhek25xk2vaj9tUnNcEl1r7tjC7T_mhQrC9kYTMtwWLANCH_arB9zENrIbpdf1tIrhrZPNm7eThNVqThbDszeFnxfY3xaUglObu0bcWtxrgIoAotMgefEgze-2Rv5F-bxmHiUjkhc84CkWYdwyLoCgA_DqvXS4QGlfueX4Ra6-o%3D)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_e=b5RXqm5YoX6d80sJGI6UnSF9RjENRoaqZMHtFl74-Ll_KTWkYbqDDDr8hkv_heTnVdugt5OVkrbuzX4qM8voX9UoMA51hK1393wIH7_JPA_NVgGLKB17g30ztnffuhQWJB1WRAn_EZfDS_hg96xaPkV_v7v8tbEgZSNyyJbq7cq3dHWCv-ZoB2fO6n2Jnrr3VHyy4lXKmg5JJpSSliIoj6rhW_fxX7DlWiXmE46yTKeQk55DFOcw4fE9nN8XMC7ps8O1BRZ2xcMO2a6ziWPQT85Z1L-V8_Cqw62w43047I05-MZtfAWl1AiKTJxqQB1ifW6MYJqW7jrlWANojWOQuXGBFwnOrzKum6E5DaHMT_epHd-0HxRtyK4sUWuMYwcvArQi59SQxAcNKtk_bYA7jFKzvE3yVJWHKRYYApWapQ0%3D)
---
But here's the problem, Peter. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud.**_
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_e=b5RXqm5YoX6d80sJGI6UnSF9RjENRoaqZMHtFl74-Ll_KTWkYbqDDDr8hkv_heTnVdugt5OVkrbuzX4qM8voX9UoMA51hK1393wIH7_JPA_NVgGLKB17g30ztnffuhQWJB1WRAn_EZfDS_hg96xaPkV_v7v8tbEgZSNyyJbq7cq3dHWCv-ZoB2fO6n2Jnrr3VHyy4lXKmg5JJpSSliIoj6rhW_fxX7DlWiXmE46yTKeQk55DFOcw4fE9nN8XMC7p_HTr1eHXXKVbnD_ZyvB9jMu8-0ptZUByWkvnK1ErKFpojq8dXZMYowZnZ7ibDiUlkV07aelZcKrnxCzW00fdLvRvkmLK-1NKoxHuwfVjFAXpeQ4La1M0YGiOMR-5Vh5tU3vgaohK3qBGf_BMXHJwgpYg5vJg-6AMk4wiBoJ5KOM%3D)
---
Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: **Freedom or Decline. ** That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_e=b5RXqm5YoX6d80sJGI6UnSF9RjENRoaqZMHtFl74-Ll_KTWkYbqDDDr8hkv_heTnVdugt5OVkrbuzX4qM8voX9UoMA51hK1393wIH7_JPA_NVgGLKB17g30ztnffuhQWJB1WRAn_EZfDS_hg96xaPkV_v7v8tbEgZSNyyJbq7cq3dHWCv-ZoB2fO6n2Jnrr3VHyy4lXKmg5JJpSSliIoj6rhW_fxX7DlWiXmE46yTKeQk55DFOcw4fE9nN8XMC7p4GOKxq32-aJGcLPeRmS6hT92AHCUALdmnynj9gRBjINu34dqZsRX66uWoiCjXV6NpJLEb6Ez3JZWb7JQXmMP5uRRMqJx9rmyq2MI7yR-ROongqf_giZriM0Vzohqx_DUQBbtr3xGkGRnb0S0z-S1-6FbtTgB3zgUmAareZxqTJA%3D)
---
| | [Chip in to my campaign here](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f32653b8d2e942d88b0408a8a78ead2e&_e=b5RXqm5YoX6d80sJGI6UnSF9RjENRoaqZMHtFl74-Ll_KTWkYbqDDDr8hkv_heTnVdugt5OVkrbuzX4qM8voX9UoMA51hK1393wIH7_JPA_NVgGLKB17g30ztnffuhQWJB1WRAn_EZfDS_hg96xaPkV_v7v8tbEgZSNyyJbq7cq3dHWCv-ZoB2fO6n2Jnrr3VHyy4lXKmg5JJpSSliIoj6rhW_fxX7DlWiXmE46yTKeQk55DFOcw4fE9nN8XMC7pwK3JT8Z2awHtW_BYUiJ7odBRgbGtTXgWJDzVIYb5vVrUUbmEPg9fGkHpF4ZKUjCiQj3QfL7TgMwUpqFzwEWDzHu3VE4wPd7xo_sh3NI3RADprZIHzS9v7-kmh9JKbsr9ttahDSIgbxIDthiA2j5oQT9U-QG86FXQOnH-1B0dIoY%3D)
---
I believe that decline is choice, success is attainable, and freedom is worth fighting for. I fought with everything I had on that debate stage and took my vision for restoring this nation directly to the American people. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I am fighting to earn your support and lead when it matters most. Friend,
---
With well over $1 million already spent on TV ads attacking me in 2023, it’s clear Wisconsin’s 1st Congressional District is National Democrat’s top target going into 2024.
---
_**In fact, there’s no other incumbent Republican in the House the Democrats have spent more money against this year.**_
---
Wisconsin’s 1st Congressional district is a pivotal battleground in 2024.
---
The communities in the 1st Congressional District will determine the control of the House, Senate, and Presidency in 2024. That’s why our race is so crucial.
---
I’ve been working hard to move historically Democrat communities in our district to the right.
---
From the suburbs of **South Milwaukee** and **Cudahy** , which have not been represented by a Republican since 1953, to the town of **St. Francis** , which a Republican has never represented, we’re bringing our conservative message to everyone.
---

clean_body: | | | | [photo attachment] Fellow American, I was just going through old family photos with my mom, and I wanted to show you one that I stumbled upon: This photo of me was taken at my small family cattle ranch – little did I know I would lose almost everything you see in this photo. In 2011, my mom and I got word that we were going to be evicted from our small ranch because of one of Obama’s big government programs. After that, we were homeless. We lived in a motel and scraped together what pocket change we could to keep gas in our car. But our story isn’t unique – we are just one of nearly 10 million households that were forced out of their homes thanks to a “ one size fits all ” government program that incentivized banks to foreclose on families during the Great Recession. But I didn’t let that stop me – I still believed in America. I knew that if I worked hard and pulled myself up by my bootstraps, I could make it. And here I am, nearly 10 years later from homeless to the House of Representatives as one of the youngest women in Congress. Unlike the majority of the elitists in Washington, I’ve seen a thing or two – so I know a thing or two. One thing is clear – your tax dollars are wasted on programs, incentives, and buyouts that have not and will not help you when you’re down . The liberal elites who have gotten rich off of these policies and programs aren’t going to fix it, so it’s up to realAmericans like you and me to fix it,Fellow American. | I sleep well at night knowing I’m doing absolutely everything that I possibly can to preserve this country. If you’re ready to do more to preserve the American Dream, American Values, and the American way of life, then please join me in fighting for this great nation. Whether you can vote for me or not, I can vote for you every day. | | | | | Thank you, | | Rep. Kat Cammack Congresswoman FL-3 | | [PAID FOR BY KAT FOR CONGRESS]() Kat Cammack 5200 NW 43rd st, suite 102-180, Gainesville, FL 32606 \- =

this is our first step to retaking the House [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Team, it's never been more clear: Our path to retaking the House runs directly through New York State. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
I'm doing everything I can to make sure that we're ready to win back the battleground districts that we lost in 2022. And now we're about to face our first real test.
George Santos has officially been expelled from Congress, which means that we're heading into a critical special election in this battleground district. And Democrats just nominated former Congressman Tom Suozzi to flip NY-03 blue! Please, will you split a gift of $5 or more between my friend Tom Suozzi and my campaign? Every dollar gets us closer to winning back this seat and retaking control of the House. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gfs_4_suozzi?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_4_suozzi?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
In 2022 New York was one of the only places in the country to see a red wave materialize. And when all the votes were counted, the four seats that the GOP picked up here — including George Santos' — were enough to retake control of the House. It was the best election cycle for Republicans here in decades.
Now, they're gearing up to expand on their victories in 2024, investing in more battleground districts and even targeting my Senate seat. But with this special election, we have a chance to stop them in their tracks.
As the sole New York Democrat at the top of the ticket in 2024, I'm doing absolutely everything that I can to fend off another red wave and build Democratic momentum across our state. But it's going to be a razor-thin race. This special election — in a district President Biden won by nearly 9 points — would give us a major advantage over the GOP. We cannot let it go to waste.
But the GOP's megadonors know exactly how important this election is. And they'll be writing huge checks to keep this district red. That's why I'm counting on your help to fight back — and the election is just a couple of short months away. Kirsten

Democrats are in trouble - every single poll that I’ve seen/conducted recently shows support for Biden and his allies in Congress is CRATERING. | [Unsubscribe](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_s=2af2412d0eb7414a858a412ec61ef51b&_t=gQgBiTLELhfzHKdy0PNoGKbkeVYtl_pZGPAc6ooFxl9-tpRrtXK0hx1mMJqskJyMO0tdSsArQC1TqRA-tlexo3ShFWV4qUJUcP3Ss3f1Uug%3D) | [Mark as Junk](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_s=2af2412d0eb7414a858a412ec61ef51b&_t=gQgBiTLELhfzHKdy0PNoGKbkeVYtl_pZGPAc6ooFxl9-tpRrtXK0hx1mMJqskJyMO0tdSsArQC1TqRA-tlexo3ShFWV4qUJUcP3Ss3f1Uug%3D)

Peter,

It's Kellyanne Conway reaching out to have a frank discussion with you ahead of the pivotal 2024 general election. Believe it or not, we are less than one year until voters head to the polls to help save our nation and get this country back on track.

If you feel like we're living in a time warp and Election Day 2020 just came to an end, believe me, you're not alone.

While so much has changed under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, the cost of living and crime have increased, so much has stayed the same.
1. Americans _still want_ lower taxes.
2. Americans are _still fighting_ for safer communities in which to raise their families.
3. And Americans simply want enough cash in their bank accounts to pay their bills and have a little fun.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." Chag Sameach, friends! I wish you all a very happy Hanukkah.

I’ve been reflecting on the importance of my Jewish faith and the bond I share with the Jewish community, and this Hanukkah I wanted to take a moment to share a little bit about how my faith has shaped my life.

**My Jewish faith was one of the core reasons I decided to enter public service.** Judaism is grounded in a commitment to fighting for those who have been left behind. The story of Passover, specifically, embedded in me the importance of fighting for justice, fairness, and freedom from a young age – and when the opportunity arose to run for Congress, I felt called to step up for Southwest Ohio.

**That’s why I chose this work: To answer the call to create a more free, just, and fair community for our children. To ensure every family has what it needs to thrive.**

My Judaism is a big part of my life, and this Hanukkah, I feel especially grateful for my faith and the beautiful community it gives me.

So, from my family to yours, happy Hanukkah. I wish you a healthy, peaceful, and blessed holiday.

_Greg_

| Donald Trump made it crystal clear that if re-elected, he’ll repeal the Affordable Care Act... name: Gavin Newsom
subject: What a "pro-life" agenda ACTUALLY looks like
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
Republicans don’t give a damn about protecting kids and they are certainly not “pro-life.”
#

Hi there, it's Gavin Newsom.
I’m about to ask you to [**make a contribution to Alex Padilla and help hold our Democratic majority in the Senate.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-december23-gn.qmBlh7&refcode=em231207-1-30&t=1&akid=1620%2E159979%2EXzBQ9d)
But first, I want to explain why it’s so important that we keep Mitch McConnell and the GOP out of power.
Here’s the truth:
**Republicans don’t give a damn about protecting kids and they are certainly not "pro-life."**
If they were interested in life, they wouldn’t cut child hunger programs.
If they were interested in life, they wouldn’t allow guns, of all things, to be the leading cause of death for our kids.
And if they were interested in life, they wouldn't — once again — be attempting to take away people’s health care through the Affordable Care Act.
They call themselves "pro-life." Spare me.
Here’s a refresher on what a "pro-life" agenda ACTUALLY looks like:
* gun safety laws
* taking action on climate change
* healthcare for all
* expanding pre-natal care
* expanding mental healthcare
* expanding childcare
* universal preschool

Look, Republicans will not stop until they can repeal the Affordable Care Act and take away people’s health care — they even tried it during the midst of a global pandemic.
That is what’s at stake with our Senate majority, and that is why it’s so important that we have the resources to take the fight to the GOP, in California and across the country.
[**If we take the fight to Republicans, on health care, on democracy, on so many things — we will win. But Alex needs your support to make it possible. Will you chip in $5 or more today?**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-december23-gn.qmBlh7&refcode=em231207-1-30&t=2&akid=1620%2E159979%2EXzBQ9d)

subject: Ryan Heads to Big Events in Iowa and South Carolina
body:
** Campaign News and Views
------------------------------------------------------------

** A Call to Action
------------------------------------------------------------
While other candidates have dropped out, Ryan continues to build momentum! Help us reach
$500,000 for media coverage in Iowa and New Hampshire, so Ryan can amplify his message of unity.
https://www.instagram.com/p/C0j7NTUuL7E/?img_index=1&mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Iowa State University
Townhall Forum
------------------------------------------------------------

Yesterday, Ryan met with students from Iowa State University for an engaging discussion. He talked about his business knowledge, and how he plans to apply it to the presidency. He also answered
questions about key issues Americans face today.

https://www.iheart.com/podcast/139-scott-voorhees-27091316/episode/holding-out-for-a-hero-133208716/?position=2&cmp=web_share&embed=true&mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID

** 1110 KFAB Interview
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan talked with Scott Voorhess about how he wants to shift the message of America from one of apathy to empathy. Listen here (https://www.iheart.com/podcast/139-scott-voorhees-27091316/episode/holding-out-for-a-hero-133208716/?position=2&cmp=web_share&embed=true&mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID)
https://zoom.us/rec/play/Z9pW1YM9EkAAZ0BZxNe1di_ei9SfTrlN9r5mvqpwUEkTayI_A4LIEWiEuMIGM9QzEb0ifNQqzxcs0KPr.8gS6nvEujw0Dul7J?canPlayFromShare=true&from=share_recording_detail&continueMode=true&componentName=rec-play&originRequestUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fzoom.us%2Frec%2Fshare%2FfOggKLGuXjB9iXTab2jVgvhFkM3NUsshnBPWa7MwD_K4Dfx-Z4URuPBOizbqniqf.9XH7Cq8XHCwqZ3Z-&mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Campaign Update Zoom Call
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan hosted an update call, inviting his many supporters to hear about his plans for December and 2024. A recording of the call is available here (https://zoom.us/rec/play/Z9pW1YM9EkAAZ0BZxNe1di_ei9SfTrlN9r5mvqpwUEkTayI_A4LIEWiEuMIGM9QzEb0ifNQqzxcs0KPr.8gS6nvEujw0Dul7J?canPlayFromShare=true&from=share_recording_detail&continueMode=true&componentName=rec-play&originRequestUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fzoom.us%2Frec%2Fshare%2FfOggKLGuXjB9iXTab2jVgvhFkM3NUsshnBPWa7MwD_K4Dfx-Z4URuPBOizbqniqf.9XH7Cq8XHCwqZ3Z-&mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID) for those who missed it.

**
Coming Up

------------------------------------------------------------

** 1st in the South Republican Action Conference
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan will attend the Republican Action Conference, one of the biggest GOP meetings in South Carolina. He will be speaking on December 8th at 12:30 pm alongside other guests such as Congressman Russell Fry. The conference takes place in Myrtle Beach, SC.
https://feenstraforcongress.com/faith-family/?mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Faith and Family Q&A
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan will appear at a Q&A hosted by Randy Feenstra and his wife Lynette. He will be joined by other presidential candidates DeSantis, Haley, and Ramaswamy. The Q&A begins at 9:00 am on December 9th, at Dordt University, Sioux Center, IA. RSVP here (https://feenstraforcongress.com/faith-family/?mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Carroll Meet and Greet
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan will host a meet and greet at Pizza Ranch, where he'll talk with the people of Iowa about how to restore our economy. The event starts at 3:00 pm on December 10th, at 425 US-30 E, Carroll, IA.

**
How Can I Help?
------------------------------------------------------------
https://calendly.com/binkley2024/calling-remote?mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID

** 90-Day Push to the Primaries
------------------------------------------------------------

Will you help bolster our outreach to voters over the next 90 days? We're asking for dedicated volunteers to make calls to Iowa and New Hampshire voters. Sign up here (https://calendly.com/binkley2024/calling-remote?mc_cid=ee5d2e89c7&mc_eid=UNIQID)
